32// Implementation of operating mode control methods
33template <typename CommType>
34bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Communication::SetOperatingMode(ChipCommMode mode) noexcept {
35 const char* mode_name = (mode == ChipCommMode::SPI_INTERNAL_RAMP) ? "SPI_INTERNAL_RAMP"
36 : (mode == ChipCommMode::SPI_EXTERNAL_STEPDIR) ? "SPI_EXTERNAL_STEPDIR"
37 : (mode == ChipCommMode::UART_INTERNAL_RAMP) ? "UART_INTERNAL_RAMP"
38 : (mode == ChipCommMode::STANDALONE_EXTERNAL_STEPDIR) ? "STANDALONE_EXTERNAL_STEPDIR"
39 : "UNKNOWN";
40 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Communication::SetOperatingMode(%s)", mode_name);
41
42 // Map mode to SPI_MODE and SD_MODE pin states
43 GpioSignal spi_mode_signal, sd_mode_signal;
44
45 switch (mode) {
46 case ChipCommMode::SPI_INTERNAL_RAMP:
47 spi_mode_signal = GpioSignal::ACTIVE; // HIGH
48 sd_mode_signal = GpioSignal::INACTIVE; // LOW
49 break;
50 case ChipCommMode::SPI_EXTERNAL_STEPDIR:
51 spi_mode_signal = GpioSignal::ACTIVE; // HIGH
52 sd_mode_signal = GpioSignal::ACTIVE; // HIGH
53 break;
54 case ChipCommMode::UART_INTERNAL_RAMP:
55 spi_mode_signal = GpioSignal::INACTIVE; // LOW
56 sd_mode_signal = GpioSignal::INACTIVE; // LOW
57 break;
58 case ChipCommMode::STANDALONE_EXTERNAL_STEPDIR:
59 spi_mode_signal = GpioSignal::INACTIVE; // LOW
60 sd_mode_signal = GpioSignal::ACTIVE; // HIGH
61 break;
62 default:
63 return false;
64 }
65
66 // Set SPI_MODE pin
67 if (!driver_.comm_.GpioSet(TMC51x0CtrlPin::SPI_MODE, spi_mode_signal)) {
68 return false;
69 }
70
71 // Set SD_MODE pin
72 if (!driver_.comm_.GpioSet(TMC51x0CtrlPin::SD_MODE, sd_mode_signal)) {
73 return false;
74 }
75
76 return true;
77}

79template <typename CommType>
80bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Communication::GetOperatingMode(ChipCommMode& mode) const noexcept {
81 GpioSignal spi_mode_signal, sd_mode_signal;
82
83 // Read SPI_MODE pin
84 if (!driver_.comm_.GpioRead(TMC51x0CtrlPin::SPI_MODE, spi_mode_signal)) {
85 return false;
86 }
87
88 // Read SD_MODE pin
89 if (!driver_.comm_.GpioRead(TMC51x0CtrlPin::SD_MODE, sd_mode_signal)) {
90 return false;
91 }
92
93 // Determine mode from pin states
94 if (spi_mode_signal == GpioSignal::ACTIVE) {
95 // SPI_MODE = HIGH
96 if (sd_mode_signal == GpioSignal::ACTIVE) {
97 mode = ChipCommMode::SPI_EXTERNAL_STEPDIR;
98 } else {
99 mode = ChipCommMode::SPI_INTERNAL_RAMP;
100 }
101 } else {
102 // SPI_MODE = LOW
103 if (sd_mode_signal == GpioSignal::ACTIVE) {
104 mode = ChipCommMode::STANDALONE_EXTERNAL_STEPDIR;
105 } else {
106 mode = ChipCommMode::UART_INTERNAL_RAMP;
107 }
108 }
109
110 return true;
111}

113// Helper function to constrain value between min and max
114template <typename T>
115static constexpr T constrain(T value, T min_val, T max_val) noexcept {
116 if (value < min_val) {
117 return min_val;
118 }
119 if (value > max_val) {
120 return max_val;
121 }
122 return value;
123}

125// Implementation of unit conversion helpers
126template <typename CommType>
127float TMC51x0<CommType>::convertSpeedToSteps(float value, Unit unit) const noexcept {
128 if (value == 0.0f)
129 return 0.0f;
130
131 // Calculate effective steps per revolution (full steps * gear ratio)
132 // Note: We do NOT include microsteps here - speedToInternal will convert to μsteps/sec
133 float effective_steps_per_rev = static_cast<float>(motor_spec_.steps_per_rev) *
134 mechanical_system_.gear_ratio;
135
136 switch (unit) {
137 case Unit::Steps:
138 return value;
139 case Unit::RPM:
140 // RPM * steps_per_rev / 60
141 return (value * effective_steps_per_rev) / 60.0f;
142 case Unit::RevPerSec:
143 // rev/s * steps_per_rev
144 return value * effective_steps_per_rev;
145 case Unit::Rad:
146 // rad/s * steps_per_rev / (2*PI)
147 return (value * effective_steps_per_rev) / (2.0f * 3.14159265359f);
148 case Unit::Deg:
149 // deg/s * steps_per_rev / 360
150 return (value * effective_steps_per_rev) / 360.0f;
151 case Unit::Mm:
152 if (mechanical_system_.system_type == MechanicalSystemType::LeadScrew &&
153 mechanical_system_.lead_screw_pitch_mm > 0.0f) {
154 // mm/s / pitch * steps_per_rev
155 return (value / mechanical_system_.lead_screw_pitch_mm) * effective_steps_per_rev;
156 } else if (mechanical_system_.system_type == MechanicalSystemType::BeltDrive &&
157 mechanical_system_.belt_pitch_mm > 0.0f && mechanical_system_.belt_pulley_teeth > 0) {
158 // mm/s / (pitch * teeth) * steps_per_rev
159 float mm_per_rev = mechanical_system_.belt_pitch_mm * static_cast<float>(mechanical_system_.belt_pulley_teeth);
160 return (value / mm_per_rev) * effective_steps_per_rev;
161 }
162 return 0.0f; // Invalid config for mm
163 default:
164 return value;
165 }
166}

168template <typename CommType>
169float TMC51x0<CommType>::convertAccelerationToSteps(float value, Unit unit) const noexcept {
170 if (value == 0.0f)
171 return 0.0f;
172
173 // RPM is not a valid acceleration unit (it's velocity only)
174 // If RPM is passed, treat it as RevPerSec and log a warning
175 if (unit == Unit::RPM) {
176 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "convertAccelerationToSteps",
177 "WARNING: RPM is not a valid acceleration unit. Converting as if RevPerSec (may be incorrect).");
178 // Fall through to treat as RevPerSec (backward compatibility, but log warning)
179 unit = Unit::RevPerSec;
180 }
181
182 // Acceleration conversions are same as velocity (per second squared)
183 return convertSpeedToSteps(value, unit);
184}

186template <typename CommType>
187float TMC51x0<CommType>::convertPositionToSteps(float value, Unit unit) const noexcept {
188 // Position conversions logic is same as speed (time unit cancels out)
189 // e.g. RPM (revs) -> Steps (revs * steps/rev)
190 // rad -> Steps
191 // mm -> Steps
192 // Note: For RPM input as position, it implies "Revolutions".
193 // Ideally we'd have a separate Unit enum for Position (Revs, Rads, Degs, Mm) vs Speed (RPM, Rad/s...)
194 // But we are reusing Unit.
195 // Unit::RPM for position -> treated as Revolutions
196
197 if (value == 0.0f)
198 return 0.0f;
199
200 float effective_steps_per_rev = static_cast<float>(motor_spec_.steps_per_rev) *
201 static_cast<float>(current_microsteps_) * mechanical_system_.gear_ratio;
202
203 switch (unit) {
204 case Unit::Steps:
205 return value;
206 case Unit::RPM: // Treated as Revolutions
207 return value * effective_steps_per_rev;
208 case Unit::RevPerSec: // Treated as Revolutions
209 return value * effective_steps_per_rev;
210 case Unit::Rad:
211 return (value * effective_steps_per_rev) / (2.0f * 3.14159265359f);
212 case Unit::Deg:
213 return (value * effective_steps_per_rev) / 360.0f;
214 case Unit::Mm:
215 if (mechanical_system_.system_type == MechanicalSystemType::LeadScrew &&
216 mechanical_system_.lead_screw_pitch_mm > 0.0f) {
217 return (value / mechanical_system_.lead_screw_pitch_mm) * effective_steps_per_rev;
218 } else if (mechanical_system_.system_type == MechanicalSystemType::BeltDrive &&
219 mechanical_system_.belt_pitch_mm > 0.0f && mechanical_system_.belt_pulley_teeth > 0) {
220 float mm_per_rev = mechanical_system_.belt_pitch_mm * static_cast<float>(mechanical_system_.belt_pulley_teeth);
221 return (value / mm_per_rev) * effective_steps_per_rev;
222 }
223 return 0.0f;
224 default:
225 return value;
226 }
227}

229template <typename CommType>
230float TMC51x0<CommType>::convertStepsToUnit(int32_t steps, Unit unit) const noexcept {
231 float effective_steps_per_rev = static_cast<float>(motor_spec_.steps_per_rev) *
232 static_cast<float>(current_microsteps_) * mechanical_system_.gear_ratio;
233
234 if (effective_steps_per_rev == 0.0f)
235 return 0.0f;
236 float val = static_cast<float>(steps);
237
238 switch (unit) {
239 case Unit::Steps:
240 return val;
241 case Unit::RPM: // Revolutions
242 return val / effective_steps_per_rev;
243 case Unit::RevPerSec: // Revolutions
244 return val / effective_steps_per_rev;
245 case Unit::Rad:
246 return (val / effective_steps_per_rev) * (2.0f * 3.14159265359f);
247 case Unit::Deg:
248 return (val / effective_steps_per_rev) * 360.0f;
249 case Unit::Mm:
250 if (mechanical_system_.system_type == MechanicalSystemType::LeadScrew) {
251 return (val / effective_steps_per_rev) * mechanical_system_.lead_screw_pitch_mm;
252 } else if (mechanical_system_.system_type == MechanicalSystemType::BeltDrive) {
253 float mm_per_rev = mechanical_system_.belt_pitch_mm * static_cast<float>(mechanical_system_.belt_pulley_teeth);
254 return (val / effective_steps_per_rev) * mm_per_rev;
255 }
256 return 0.0f;
257 default:
258 return val;
259 }
260}

262template <typename CommType>
263float TMC51x0<CommType>::convertSpeedToUnit(float steps_per_sec, Unit unit) const noexcept {
264 // Logic similar to steps->unit but scaling for time if needed
265 // Steps/s -> RPM: (Steps/s / Steps/rev) * 60
266 // Note: Input is in full steps/sec (from speedFromInternal), so we do NOT include microsteps here
267
268 float effective_steps_per_rev = static_cast<float>(motor_spec_.steps_per_rev) *
269 mechanical_system_.gear_ratio;
270
271 if (effective_steps_per_rev == 0.0f)
272 return 0.0f;
273
274 switch (unit) {
275 case Unit::Steps:
276 return steps_per_sec;
277 case Unit::RPM:
278 return (steps_per_sec / effective_steps_per_rev) * 60.0f;
279 case Unit::RevPerSec:
280 return steps_per_sec / effective_steps_per_rev;
281 case Unit::Rad:
282 return (steps_per_sec / effective_steps_per_rev) * (2.0f * 3.14159265359f);
283 case Unit::Deg:
284 return (steps_per_sec / effective_steps_per_rev) * 360.0f;
285 case Unit::Mm:
286 if (mechanical_system_.system_type == MechanicalSystemType::LeadScrew) {
287 return (steps_per_sec / effective_steps_per_rev) * mechanical_system_.lead_screw_pitch_mm;
288 } else if (mechanical_system_.system_type == MechanicalSystemType::BeltDrive) {
289 float mm_per_rev = mechanical_system_.belt_pitch_mm * static_cast<float>(mechanical_system_.belt_pulley_teeth);
290 return (steps_per_sec / effective_steps_per_rev) * mm_per_rev;
291 }
292 return 0.0f;
293 default:
294 return steps_per_sec;
295 }
296}

298template <typename CommType>
299bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Initialize(const DriverConfig& config) noexcept {
300 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Initialize(toff=%u, mres=%u)", config.chopper.toff,
301 static_cast<uint8_t>(config.chopper.mres));
302
303 // Store physical configuration
304 motor_spec_ = config.motor_spec;
305 mechanical_system_ = config.mechanical;
306
307 // Configure clock source
308 if (!communication.SetClkFreq(config.external_clk_config)) {
309 return false;
310 }
311
312 // Calculate initial microsteps from config
313 // mres: 0=256, 1=128, ... 8=fullstep. microsteps = 256 >> mres
314 uint8_t mres = constrain<uint8_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(config.chopper.mres), 0U, 8U);
315 current_microsteps_ = 256U >> mres;
316
317 // Configure motor current from motor specifications
318 if (!motorControl.ConfigureMotorCurrent(motor_spec_)) {
319 return false;
320 }
321
322 // Validate StealthChop lower limit if resistance is available
323 if (motor_spec_.winding_resistance_mohm > 0) {
324 uint16_t run_current = motor_spec_.run_current_ma;
325 if (run_current == 0) {
326 run_current = motor_spec_.rated_current_ma;
327 }
328 if (run_current > 0) {
329 uint16_t lower_limit = CalculateStealthChopLowerLimit(motor_spec_, motor_spec_.supply_voltage_mv,
330 config.chopper.tbl, config.stealthchop.pwm_freq, f_clk_);
331 if (lower_limit > 0) {
332 float run_current_a = static_cast<float>(run_current) / 1000.0f;
333 float lower_limit_a = static_cast<float>(lower_limit) / 1000.0f;
334 if (run_current_a < lower_limit_a * 1.1f) {
335 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC5160",
336 "WARNING: Run current (%.1fmA) may be below StealthChop lower limit (%.1fmA)", run_current,
337 lower_limit);
338 }
339 }
340 }
341 }
342
343 // Clear reset and error flags
344 GSTAT_Register gstat{};
345 gstat.bits.reset = true;
346 gstat.bits.drv_err = true;
347 gstat.bits.uv_cp = true;
348 if (!this->comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::GSTAT, gstat.value, this->GetCommAddress())) {
349 return false;
350 }
351
352 // Configure power stage
353 if (!motorControl.ConfigurePowerStage(config.power_stage)) {
354 return false;
355 }
356
357 // Configure short protection (convert user-friendly values to register values)
358 SHORT_CONF_Register short_conf{};
359
360 // Calculate S2VS_LEVEL from voltage threshold
361 uint16_t s2vs_voltage = config.power_stage.s2vs_voltage_mv;
362 if (s2vs_voltage == 0) {
363 s2vs_voltage = 625; // Default recommended: 625mV (S2VS_LEVEL=6)
364 }
365 uint8_t s2vs_level = CalculateS2VSLevel(s2vs_voltage);
366 if (s2vs_level == 0 || s2vs_level < 4) {
367 s2vs_level = 6; // Fallback to default
368 }
369 short_conf.bits.s2vs_level = constrain<uint8_t>(s2vs_level, 4U, 15U);
370
371 // Calculate S2G_LEVEL from voltage threshold (consider supply voltage for VS>52V check)
372 uint16_t s2g_voltage = config.power_stage.s2g_voltage_mv;
373 if (s2g_voltage == 0) {
374 s2g_voltage = 625; // Default recommended: 625mV (S2G_LEVEL=6)
375 }
376 uint8_t s2g_level = CalculateS2GLevel(s2g_voltage, motor_spec_.supply_voltage_mv);
377 if (s2g_level == 0 || s2g_level < 2) {
378 s2g_level = 6; // Fallback to default
379 }
380 short_conf.bits.s2g_level = constrain<uint8_t>(s2g_level, 2U, 15U);
381
382 short_conf.bits.shortfilter =
383 constrain<decltype(config.power_stage.shortfilter)>(config.power_stage.shortfilter, 0U, 3U);
384
385 // Calculate shortdelay from detection delay time
386 uint8_t delay_us_x10 = config.power_stage.short_detection_delay_us_x10;
387 if (delay_us_x10 == 0) {
388 delay_us_x10 = 8; // Default recommended: 0.8µs (typical 0.85µs, shortdelay=0)
389 }
390 uint8_t shortdelay = CalculateShortDelay(delay_us_x10);
391 short_conf.bits.shortdelay = constrain<uint8_t>(shortdelay, 0U, 1U);
392
393 if (!this->comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SHORT_CONF, short_conf.value, this->GetCommAddress())) {
394 return false;
395 }
396 this->write_only_regs_.short_conf = short_conf.value;
397
398 // Configure chopper
399 if (!motorControl.ConfigureChopper(config.chopper)) {
400 return false;
401 }
402
403 // Configure StealthChop
404 if (!motorControl.ConfigureStealthChop(config.stealthchop)) {
405 return false;
406 }
407
408 // Set ramp mode to positioning
409 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC5160", "Initialize: Setting ramp mode to POSITIONING");
410 if (!rampControl.SetRampMode(RampMode::POSITIONING)) {
411 return false;
412 }
413
414 // Detect chip version (read from IOIN register)
415 uint8_t chip_version = 0;
416 if (diagnostics.ReadIcVersion(chip_version)) {
417 chip_version_ = chip_version;
418 if (chip_version == ChipVersion::TMC5130) {
419 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Detected TMC5130 chip (version 0x%02X)", chip_version);
420 } else if (chip_version == ChipVersion::TMC5160) {
421 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Detected TMC5160 chip (version 0x%02X)", chip_version);
422 } else {
423 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC5160", "Unknown chip version: 0x%02X", chip_version);
424 }
425 } else {
426 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC5160", "Failed to read chip version, assuming TMC5160");
427 chip_version_ = ChipVersion::TMC5160; // Default to TMC5160
428 }
429
430 // Configure global settings (GCONF)
431 // Read-Modify-Write to preserve reserved bits (bits 18-31)
432 uint32_t gconf_value = 0;
433 if (!this->comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::GCONF, gconf_value, this->GetCommAddress())) {
434 return false;
435 }
436 GCONF_Register gconf{};
437 gconf.value = gconf_value;
438
439 gconf.bits.recalibrate = config.global_config.recalibrate ? 1 : 0;
440 gconf.bits.faststandstill = config.global_config.en_short_standstill_timeout ? 1 : 0;
441 gconf.bits.en_pwm_mode = config.global_config.en_stealthchop_mode ? 1 : 0;
442 gconf.bits.multistep_filt = config.global_config.en_stealthchop_step_filter ? 1 : 0;
443 // Use direction from config (global_config.invert_direction can override via ConfigureGlobalConfig if
444 // needed)
445 gconf.bits.shaft = (config.direction == MotorDirection::INVERSE) ? 1 : 0;
446 gconf.bits.diag0_error = config.global_config.diag0.error ? 1 : 0;
447 gconf.bits.diag0_otpw = config.global_config.diag0.otpw ? 1 : 0;
448 gconf.bits.diag0_stall_step = config.global_config.diag0.stall_step ? 1 : 0;
449 gconf.bits.diag1_stall_dir = config.global_config.diag1.stall_dir ? 1 : 0;
450 gconf.bits.diag1_index = config.global_config.diag1.index ? 1 : 0;
451 gconf.bits.diag1_onstate = config.global_config.diag1.onstate ? 1 : 0;
452 gconf.bits.diag1_steps_skipped = config.global_config.diag1.steps_skipped ? 1 : 0;
453 gconf.bits.diag0_int_pushpull = config.global_config.diag0.pushpull ? 1 : 0;
454 gconf.bits.diag1_poscomp_pushpull = config.global_config.diag1.pushpull ? 1 : 0;
455 gconf.bits.small_hysteresis = config.global_config.en_small_step_frequency_hysteresis ? 1 : 0;
456 gconf.bits.stop_enable = config.global_config.enca_dcin_sequencer_stop ? 1 : 0;
457 gconf.bits.direct_mode = config.global_config.direct_mode ? 1 : 0;
458 gconf.bits.test_mode = 0; // Always disabled (factory test mode, not for user)
459 // Reserved bits (18-31) are preserved from read value
460
461 if (!this->comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::GCONF, gconf.value, this->GetCommAddress())) {
462 return false;
463 }
464
465 // Configure ramp generator
466 if (!rampControl.ConfigureRamp(config.ramp_config)) {
467 return false;
468 }
469
470 // Configure reference switches (defaults are safe/disabled)
471 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Initialize: Configuring reference switches");
472 if (!rampControl.ConfigureReferenceSwitch(config.reference_switch_config)) {
473 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC5160", "Failed to configure reference switches");
474 return false;
475 }
476
477 // Configure encoder (defaults are safe/disabled)
478 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Initialize: Configuring encoder");
479 if (!encoder.Configure(config.encoder_config)) {
480 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC5160", "Failed to configure encoder");
481 return false;
482 }
483
484 // Set encoder resolution if encoder pulses per rev is configured
485 if (config.encoder_config.pulses_per_rev > 0) {
486 // Use motor output steps (accounting for gearbox if present)
487 // motor_spec.steps_per_rev is motor steps, mechanical.gear_ratio accounts for gearbox
488 int32_t motor_output_steps =
489 static_cast<int32_t>(static_cast<float>(motor_spec_.steps_per_rev) * mechanical_system_.gear_ratio);
490
491 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160",
492 "Initialize: Setting encoder resolution (motor_steps=%ld, enc_pulses=%u, invert=%s)",
493 motor_output_steps, config.encoder_config.pulses_per_rev,
494 config.encoder_config.invert_direction ? "true" : "false");
495 if (!encoder.SetResolution(motor_output_steps, static_cast<int32_t>(config.encoder_config.pulses_per_rev),
496 config.encoder_config.invert_direction)) {
497 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC5160", "Failed to set encoder resolution");
498 return false;
499 }
500 }
501
502 // Configure UART node address if set (only used in UART mode)
503 if (config.uart_config.node_address > 0 || config.uart_config.send_delay > 0) {
504 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Initialize: Configuring UART node address (address=%u, send_delay=%u)",
505 config.uart_config.node_address, config.uart_config.send_delay);
506 if (!communication.ConfigureUartNodeAddress(config.uart_config.node_address, config.uart_config.send_delay)) {
507 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC5160", "Failed to configure UART node address");
508 return false;
509 }
510 }
511
512 // Configure StallGuard2 (defaults are safe/disabled)
513 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Initialize: Configuring StallGuard2");
514 if (!diagnostics.ConfigureStallGuard(config.stallguard)) {
515 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC5160", "Failed to configure StallGuard2");
516 return false;
517 }
518
519 // Configure CoolStep (defaults are safe/disabled)
520 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Initialize: Configuring CoolStep");
521 if (!motorControl.ConfigureCoolStep(config.coolstep)) {
522 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC5160", "Failed to configure CoolStep");
523 return false;
524 }
525
526 // Configure DcStep (defaults are safe/disabled)
527 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Initialize: Configuring DcStep");
528 if (!motorControl.ConfigureDcStep(config.dcstep)) {
529 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC5160", "Failed to configure DcStep");
530 return false;
531 }
532
533 // Store configuration (will be updated on all runtime changes via Configure* methods)
534 driver_config_ = config;
535
536 initialized_ = true;
537 return true;
538}

540template <typename CommType>
541bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Reset() noexcept {
542 GSTAT_Register gstat{};
543 gstat.bits.reset = true;
544 return this->comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::GSTAT, gstat.value, this->GetCommAddress());
545}

547template <typename CommType>
548int32_t TMC51x0<CommType>::speedToInternal(float speed_hz) const noexcept {
549 // Datasheet formula: v[Hz] = v[5160] * (f_CLK[Hz]/2 / 2^23)
550 // Rearranged: v[5160] = v[Hz] * 2^24 / f_CLK
551 // Where v[Hz] is in μsteps/s (microsteps per second)
552 // Input speed_hz is in steps/s, so we multiply by microstep count (USC) to convert to μsteps/s
553 // Final: v[5160] = (speed_hz * USC) * 2^24 / f_CLK
554 // Note: USC (microstep count) is tracked in current_microsteps_ and can vary (256, 128, 64, etc.)
555 if (speed_hz == 0.0F) {
556 return 0;
557 }
558 float internal = (speed_hz * static_cast<float>(1UL << 24)) / static_cast<float>(f_clk_);
559 internal *= static_cast<float>(current_microsteps_);
560 return static_cast<int32_t>(internal);
561}
562
563template <typename CommType>
564float TMC51x0<CommType>::speedFromInternal(int32_t speed_internal) const noexcept {
565 // Datasheet formula: v[Hz] = v[5160] * (f_CLK[Hz]/2 / 2^23)
566 // Where v[Hz] is in μsteps/s (microsteps per second)
567 // Output is in steps/s, so we divide by microstep count (USC) to convert from μsteps/s
568 // Final: v[steps/s] = (v[5160] * f_CLK / 2^24) / USC
569 // Note: USC (microstep count) is tracked in current_microsteps_ and can vary (256, 128, 64, etc.)
570 if (speed_internal == 0) {
571 return 0.0F;
572 }
573 float speed_hz = static_cast<float>(speed_internal) * static_cast<float>(f_clk_) / static_cast<float>(1UL << 24);
574 speed_hz /= static_cast<float>(current_microsteps_);
575 return speed_hz;
576}
577
578template <typename CommType>
579int32_t TMC51x0<CommType>::accelToInternal(float accel_hz) const noexcept {
580 // Datasheet formula: a[Hz/s] = a[5160] * f_CLK[Hz]^2 / (512*256) / 2^24
581 // Rearranged: a[5160] = a[Hz/s] * (512*256) * 2^24 / f_CLK^2
582 // Where a[Hz/s] is in μsteps/s² (microsteps per second squared)
583 // Input accel_hz is in steps/s², so we multiply by microstep count (USC) to convert to μsteps/s²
584 // Final: a[5160] = (accel_hz * USC) * (512*256) * 2^24 / f_CLK^2
585 // Note: USC (microstep count) is tracked in current_microsteps_ and can vary (256, 128, 64, etc.)
586 // Note: The 256 in (512*256) is a fixed constant from the datasheet formula, not the microstep count
587 if (accel_hz == 0.0F) {
588 return 0;
589 }
590 float internal = accel_hz * 512.0F * 256.0F * static_cast<float>(1UL << 24) /
591 (static_cast<float>(f_clk_) * static_cast<float>(f_clk_));
592 internal *= static_cast<float>(current_microsteps_);
593 return static_cast<int32_t>(internal);
594}
595
596template <typename CommType>
597int32_t TMC51x0<CommType>::thresholdSpeedToTstep(float speed_hz) const noexcept {
598 // Datasheet formula: TSTEP = f_CLK / f256STEP = f_CLK / (fSTEP*256/USC)
599 // Where fSTEP is in μsteps/s, USC is microstep count (can vary: 256, 128, 64, etc.)
600 // Input speed_hz is in steps/s, so fSTEP = speed_hz * USC (convert to μsteps/s)
601 // Final: TSTEP = f_CLK / (speed_hz * USC)
602 // Note: USC (microstep count) is tracked in current_microsteps_ and can vary
603 // TSTEP is 20-bit unsigned (max value 0xFFFFF = 1048575)
604 if (speed_hz == 0.0F) {
605 return 0;
606 }
607 float tstep = static_cast<float>(f_clk_) / (speed_hz * static_cast<float>(current_microsteps_));
608 tstep = std::max(0.0F, std::min(1048575.0F, tstep));
609 return static_cast<int32_t>(tstep);
610}

612// RampControl implementation
613template <typename CommType>
614bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::SetRampMode(RampMode mode) noexcept {
615 auto mode_value = static_cast<uint8_t>(mode);
616 const char* mode_name = (mode == RampMode::POSITIONING) ? "POSITIONING"
617 : (mode == RampMode::VELOCITY_POS) ? "VELOCITY_POS"
618 : (mode == RampMode::VELOCITY_NEG) ? "VELOCITY_NEG"
619 : "HOLD";
620 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "RampControl::SetRampMode(%s)", mode_name);
621
622 // Read-Modify-Write to preserve reserved bits (bits 2-31)
623 uint32_t rampmode_value = 0;
624 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::RAMPMODE, rampmode_value, driver_.GetCommAddress())) {
625 return false;
626 }
627 // Clear mode bits (0-1) and set new mode, preserve reserved bits (2-31)
628 rampmode_value = (rampmode_value & 0xFFFFFFFCU) | (mode_value & 0x03U);
629 return driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::RAMPMODE, rampmode_value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
630}

636 return false;
637 }
638 uint8_t mode_bits = static_cast<uint8_t>(rampmode_value & 0x03U);
639 mode = static_cast<RampMode>(mode_bits);
640 return true;
641}

796template <typename CommType>
797bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::SetMaxSpeed(float value, Unit unit) noexcept {
798 float steps_per_sec = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(value, unit);
799 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "RampControl::SetMaxSpeed(%.2f steps/s)", steps_per_sec);
800
801 int32_t internal = driver_.speedToInternal(std::abs(steps_per_sec));
802 internal = std::min(internal, static_cast<decltype(internal)>(0x7FFFFF)); // VMAX is 23 bits
803 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::VMAX, static_cast<uint32_t>(internal));
804 if (success) {
805 driver_.write_only_regs_.vmax = static_cast<uint32_t>(internal);
806 // Update driver config if in steps unit
807 if (unit == Unit::Steps) {
808 driver_.driver_config_.ramp_config.vmax = value;
809 }
810 }
811 if (!success) {
812 return false;
813 }
814 // If in velocity mode, update direction
815 uint32_t rampmode = 0;
816 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::RAMPMODE, rampmode, driver_.GetCommAddress())) {
817 if ((rampmode & 0x03U) == static_cast<uint8_t>(RampMode::VELOCITY_POS) ||
818 (rampmode & 0x03U) == static_cast<uint8_t>(RampMode::VELOCITY_NEG)) {
819 uint8_t new_mode = (steps_per_sec < 0.0F) ? static_cast<uint8_t>(RampMode::VELOCITY_NEG)
820 : static_cast<uint8_t>(RampMode::VELOCITY_POS);
821 // Read-Modify-Write to preserve reserved bits (bits 2-31)
822 rampmode = (rampmode & 0xFFFFFFFCU) | (new_mode & 0x03U);
823 driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::RAMPMODE, rampmode, driver_.GetCommAddress());
824 }
825 }
826 return true;
827}

829template <typename CommType>

833
834template <typename CommType>
835bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::SetAccelerations(float accel_val, float decel_val, Unit unit) noexcept {
836 float accel_steps = driver_.convertAccelerationToSteps(accel_val, unit);
837 float decel_steps = driver_.convertAccelerationToSteps(decel_val, unit);
838
839 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "RampControl::SetAccelerations(accel=%.2f, decel=%.2f steps/s²)",
840 accel_steps, decel_steps);
841
842 int32_t accel_internal = driver_.accelToInternal(std::abs(accel_steps));
843 int32_t decel_internal = driver_.accelToInternal(std::abs(decel_steps));
844 accel_internal = std::min(accel_internal,
845 static_cast<decltype(accel_internal)>(0xFFFF)); // AMAX/DMAX are 16 bits
846 decel_internal = std::min(decel_internal, static_cast<decltype(decel_internal)>(0xFFFF));
847 bool success = true;
848 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::AMAX, static_cast<uint32_t>(accel_internal));
849 if (success) {
850 driver_.write_only_regs_.amax = static_cast<uint32_t>(accel_internal);
851 }
852 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::DMAX, static_cast<uint32_t>(decel_internal));
853 if (success) {
854 driver_.write_only_regs_.dmax = static_cast<uint32_t>(decel_internal);
855 // Update driver config if in steps unit
856 if (unit == Unit::Steps) {
857 driver_.driver_config_.ramp_config.amax = accel_val;
858 driver_.driver_config_.ramp_config.dmax = decel_val;
859 }
860 }
861 return success;
862}

866 float decel_steps = driver_.convertAccelerationToSteps(value, unit);
867 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "RampControl::SetDeceleration(decel=%.2f steps/s²)", decel_steps);
868 int32_t decel_internal = driver_.accelToInternal(std::abs(decel_steps));
869 decel_internal = std::min(decel_internal, static_cast<decltype(decel_internal)>(0xFFFF)); // DMAX is 16 bits
870 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::DMAX, static_cast<uint32_t>(decel_internal));
871 if (success) {
872 driver_.write_only_regs_.dmax = static_cast<uint32_t>(decel_internal);

877template <typename CommType>
878bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::SetRampSpeeds(float start_speed, float stop_speed, float transition_speed,
879 Unit unit) noexcept {
880 float start_steps = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(start_speed, unit);
881 float stop_steps = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(stop_speed, unit);
882 float transition_steps = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(transition_speed, unit);
883
884 int32_t vstart = driver_.speedToInternal(std::abs(start_steps));
885 int32_t vstop = driver_.speedToInternal(std::abs(stop_steps));
886 int32_t v1 = driver_.speedToInternal(std::abs(transition_steps));
887 vstart = std::min(vstart, static_cast<decltype(vstart)>(0x3FFFF)); // VSTART is 18 bits
888 vstop = std::min(vstop,
889 static_cast<decltype(vstop)>(0x3FFFF)); // VSTOP is 18 bits
890 v1 = std::min(v1, static_cast<decltype(v1)>(0xFFFFF)); // V1 is 20 bits
891 bool success = true;
892 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::VSTART, static_cast<uint32_t>(vstart));
893 if (success) {
894 driver_.write_only_regs_.vstart = static_cast<uint32_t>(vstart);
895 }
896 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::VSTOP, static_cast<uint32_t>(vstop));
897 if (success) {
898 driver_.write_only_regs_.vstop = static_cast<uint32_t>(vstop);
899 }
900 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::V_1, static_cast<uint32_t>(v1));
901 if (success) {
902 driver_.write_only_regs_.v_1 = static_cast<uint32_t>(v1);
903 // Update driver config if in steps unit
904 if (unit == Unit::Steps) {
905 driver_.driver_config_.ramp_config.vstart = start_speed;
906 driver_.driver_config_.ramp_config.vstop = stop_speed;
907 driver_.driver_config_.ramp_config.v1 = transition_speed;
908 }
909 }
910 return success;
911}

913template <typename CommType>
914bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::GetCurrentSpeed(float& speed, Unit unit) noexcept {
915 uint32_t value = 0;
916 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::VACTUAL, value)) {
917 return false;
918 }
919 // VACTUAL is 24-bit signed
920 auto signed_value = static_cast<int32_t>(value);
921 if (signed_value & 0x800000) {
922 signed_value |= static_cast<int32_t>(0xFF000000U); // Sign extend
923 }
924 float steps_per_sec = driver_.speedFromInternal(signed_value);
925 speed = driver_.convertSpeedToUnit(steps_per_sec, unit);
926 return true;
927}

965template <typename CommType>
966bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::ConfigureReferenceSwitch(const ReferenceSwitchConfig& config) noexcept {
967 // Update driver config
968 driver_.driver_config_.reference_switch_config = config;
969
970 // Read-Modify-Write to preserve other SW_MODE bits (like sg_stop)
971 uint32_t sw_mode_val = 0;
972 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode_val)) {
973 return false;
974 }
975 SW_MODE_Register sw_mode{};
976 sw_mode.value = sw_mode_val;
977
978 // Use stop enable flags (independent of active level)
979 // Allows enabling/disabling motor stop in real-time while keeping polarity configured
980 sw_mode.bits.stop_l_enable = config.left_switch_stop_enable ? 1 : 0;
981 sw_mode.bits.stop_r_enable = config.right_switch_stop_enable ? 1 : 0;
982
983 // Compute polarity from active level (ACTIVE_LOW = inverted polarity = true, ACTIVE_HIGH = normal = false)
984 sw_mode.bits.pol_stop_l = (config.left_switch_active == ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel::ACTIVE_LOW) ? 1 : 0;
985 sw_mode.bits.pol_stop_r = (config.right_switch_active == ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel::ACTIVE_LOW) ? 1 : 0;
986
987 sw_mode.bits.swap_lr = config.swap_left_right ? 1 : 0;
988
989 // Compute latching flags from enum
990 sw_mode.bits.latch_l_active =
991 (config.latch_left == ReferenceLatchMode::ACTIVE_EDGE || config.latch_left == ReferenceLatchMode::BOTH_EDGES) ? 1
992 : 0;
993 sw_mode.bits.latch_l_inactive =
994 (config.latch_left == ReferenceLatchMode::INACTIVE_EDGE || config.latch_left == ReferenceLatchMode::BOTH_EDGES)
995 ? 1
996 : 0;
997 sw_mode.bits.latch_r_active =
998 (config.latch_right == ReferenceLatchMode::ACTIVE_EDGE || config.latch_right == ReferenceLatchMode::BOTH_EDGES)
999 ? 1
1000 : 0;
1001 sw_mode.bits.latch_r_inactive =
1002 (config.latch_right == ReferenceLatchMode::INACTIVE_EDGE || config.latch_right == ReferenceLatchMode::BOTH_EDGES)
1003 ? 1
1004 : 0;
1005
1006 sw_mode.bits.en_latch_encoder = config.en_latch_encoder ? 1 : 0;
1007 sw_mode.bits.en_softstop = (config.stop_mode == ReferenceStopMode::SOFT_STOP) ? 1 : 0;
1008
1009 return driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1010}
1011
1012template <typename CommType>
1013bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::GetReferenceSwitchConfig(ReferenceSwitchConfig& config) noexcept {
1014 uint32_t sw_mode_val = 0;
1015 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode_val)) {
1016 return false;
1017 }
1018 SW_MODE_Register sw_mode{};
1019 sw_mode.value = sw_mode_val;
1020
1021 // Read stop enable flags
1022 config.left_switch_stop_enable = (sw_mode.bits.stop_l_enable != 0);
1023 config.right_switch_stop_enable = (sw_mode.bits.stop_r_enable != 0);
1024
1025 // Read polarity and convert to active level
1026 config.left_switch_active =
1027 (sw_mode.bits.pol_stop_l != 0) ? ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel::ACTIVE_LOW : ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel::ACTIVE_HIGH;
1028 config.right_switch_active =
1029 (sw_mode.bits.pol_stop_r != 0) ? ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel::ACTIVE_LOW : ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel::ACTIVE_HIGH;
1030
1031 // Read swap
1032 config.swap_left_right = (sw_mode.bits.swap_lr != 0);
1033
1034 // Read latching modes
1035 bool latch_l_active = (sw_mode.bits.latch_l_active != 0);
1036 bool latch_l_inactive = (sw_mode.bits.latch_l_inactive != 0);
1037 if (latch_l_active && latch_l_inactive) {
1038 config.latch_left = ReferenceLatchMode::BOTH_EDGES;
1039 } else if (latch_l_active) {
1040 config.latch_left = ReferenceLatchMode::ACTIVE_EDGE;
1041 } else if (latch_l_inactive) {
1042 config.latch_left = ReferenceLatchMode::INACTIVE_EDGE;
1043 } else {
1044 config.latch_left = ReferenceLatchMode::DISABLED;
1045 }
1046
1047 bool latch_r_active = (sw_mode.bits.latch_r_active != 0);
1048 bool latch_r_inactive = (sw_mode.bits.latch_r_inactive != 0);
1049 if (latch_r_active && latch_r_inactive) {
1050 config.latch_right = ReferenceLatchMode::BOTH_EDGES;
1051 } else if (latch_r_active) {
1052 config.latch_right = ReferenceLatchMode::ACTIVE_EDGE;
1053 } else if (latch_r_inactive) {
1054 config.latch_right = ReferenceLatchMode::INACTIVE_EDGE;
1055 } else {
1056 config.latch_right = ReferenceLatchMode::DISABLED;
1057 }
1058
1059 // Read encoder latching
1060 config.en_latch_encoder = (sw_mode.bits.en_latch_encoder != 0);
1061
1062 // Read stop mode
1063 config.stop_mode = (sw_mode.bits.en_softstop != 0) ? ReferenceStopMode::SOFT_STOP : ReferenceStopMode::HARD_STOP;
1064
1065 return true;
1066}

1169template <typename CommType>
1170bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::SetPowerDownDelayMs(float delay_ms) noexcept {
1171 // TPOWERDOWN: time_ms = tpowerdown * 2^18 / fCLK * 1000
1172 // Rearranged: tpowerdown = time_ms * fCLK / (2^18 * 1000)
1173 float tpowerdown_reg = (delay_ms * static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_)) / (262144.0f * 1000.0f);
1174 uint8_t tpowerdown = constrain<uint8_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(std::round(tpowerdown_reg)), 0U, 255U);
1175 return SetPowerDownDelay(tpowerdown);
1176}

1187template <typename CommType>
1188bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::SetZeroWaitTimeMs(float delay_ms) noexcept {
1189 // TZEROWAIT: time_ms = tzerowait * 2^18 / fCLK * 1000
1190 // Rearranged: tzerowait = time_ms * fCLK / (2^18 * 1000)
1191 float tzerowait_reg = (delay_ms * static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_)) / (262144.0f * 1000.0f);
1192 uint16_t tzerowait = constrain<uint16_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(std::round(tzerowait_reg)), 0U, 65535U);
1193 return SetZeroWaitTime(tzerowait);
1194}
1195
1196template <typename CommType>
1197bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::ConfigureRamp(const RampConfig& config) noexcept {
1198 // Update driver config
1199 driver_.driver_config_.ramp_config = config;
1200
1201 // Set timing parameters first (convert from milliseconds to register values)
1202 if (config.tpowerdown_ms >= 0.0f) {
1203 float tpowerdown_reg = (config.tpowerdown_ms * static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_)) / (262144.0f * 1000.0f);
1204 uint8_t tpowerdown = constrain<uint8_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(std::round(tpowerdown_reg)), 0U, 255U);
1205 if (!SetPowerDownDelay(tpowerdown)) {
1206 return false;
1207 }
1208 }
1209
1210 if (config.tzerowait_ms >= 0.0f) {
1211 float tzerowait_reg = (config.tzerowait_ms * static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_)) / (262144.0f * 1000.0f);
1212 uint16_t tzerowait = constrain<uint16_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(std::round(tzerowait_reg)), 0U, 65535U);
1213 if (!SetZeroWaitTime(tzerowait)) {
1214 return false;
1215 }
1216 }
1217
1218 // Get unit specifications for proper conversion
1219 Unit velocity_unit = config.velocity_unit;
1220 Unit acceleration_unit = config.acceleration_unit;
1221
1222 // Set velocity parameters (VSTART, VSTOP, V1) using specified unit
1223 float vstart = config.vstart;
1224 float vstop = config.vstop;
1225 float v1 = config.v1;
1226
1227 // Ensure VSTOP >= VSTART (datasheet requirement)
1228 if (vstop < vstart && vstart > 0.0f) {
1229 vstop = vstart; // Use VSTART if VSTOP is less
1230 } else if (vstop == 0.0f && vstart == 0.0f) {
1231 vstop = 10.0f; // Default minimum VSTOP
1232 }
1233
1234 if (!SetRampSpeeds(vstart, vstop, v1, velocity_unit)) {
1235 return false;
1236 }
1237
1238 // Set maximum velocity if configured (VMAX) using specified unit
1239 if (config.vmax > 0.0f) {
1240 if (!SetMaxSpeed(config.vmax, velocity_unit)) {
1241 return false;
1242 }
1243 }
1244
1245 // Set acceleration parameters using specified unit
1246 if (config.amax > 0.0f) {
1247 float dmax = (config.dmax > 0.0f) ? config.dmax : config.amax;
1248 if (!SetAccelerations(config.amax, dmax, acceleration_unit)) {
1249 return false;
1250 }
1251 }
1252
1253 // A1 (first acceleration, used between VSTART and V1) using specified unit
1254 if (config.a1 > 0.0f) {
1255 if (!SetFirstAcceleration(config.a1, acceleration_unit)) {
1256 return false;
1257 }
1258 }
1259
1260 // D1 (first deceleration, used between VSTOP and V1, must not be 0 in positioning mode) using specified unit
1261 if (config.d1 > 0.0f) {
1262 if (!SetFinalDeceleration(config.d1, acceleration_unit)) {
1263 return false;
1264 }
1265 } else {
1266 // Set default D1 if not configured (required for positioning mode)
1267 if (!SetFinalDeceleration(100.0f, Unit::Steps)) {
1268 return false;
1269 }
1270 }
1271
1272 return true;
1273}
1274
1275template <typename CommType>
1276bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::SetFirstAcceleration(float a1, Unit unit) noexcept {
1277 float a1_steps = driver_.convertAccelerationToSteps(a1, unit);
1278 uint32_t a1_value = 0;
1279 if (a1_steps == 0.0F) {
1280 // Set to 0 to use AMAX for this phase
1281 a1_value = 0;
1282 } else {
1283 int32_t a1_internal = driver_.accelToInternal(std::abs(a1_steps));
1284 a1_internal = std::min(a1_internal, static_cast<decltype(a1_internal)>(0xFFFF)); // A_1 is 16 bits
1285 a1_value = static_cast<uint32_t>(a1_internal);
1286 }
1287 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::A_1, a1_value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1288 if (success) {
1289 driver_.write_only_regs_.a_1 = a1_value;
1290 // Update driver config if in steps unit
1291 if (unit == Unit::Steps) {
1292 driver_.driver_config_.ramp_config.a1 = a1;
1293 }
1294 }
1295 return success;
1296}
1297
1298template <typename CommType>
1299bool TMC51x0<CommType>::RampControl::SetFinalDeceleration(float d1, Unit unit) noexcept {
1300 float d1_steps = driver_.convertAccelerationToSteps(d1, unit);
1301 if (d1_steps == 0.0F) {
1302 // Datasheet warning: "Attention: Do not set 0 in positioning mode, even if V1=0!"
1303 // We allow setting 0 here as it might be used in other modes or user intends it,
1304 // but we log a warning if logging is enabled?
1305 // For now, we just pass it through, but user should be aware.
1306 }
1307 int32_t d1_internal = driver_.accelToInternal(std::abs(d1_steps));
1308 d1_internal = std::min(d1_internal,
1309 static_cast<decltype(d1_internal)>(0xFFFF)); // D_1 is 16 bits
1310 // Ensure value is at least 1 if user tries to set very low non-zero value that rounds to 0?
1311 // The register range starts at 1.
1312 if (d1_internal == 0 && d1_steps != 0.0F) {
1313 d1_internal = 1;
1314 }
1315 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::D_1, static_cast<uint32_t>(d1_internal));
1316 if (success) {
1317 driver_.write_only_regs_.d_1 = static_cast<uint32_t>(d1_internal);
1318 }
1319 return success;
1320}
1321
1322// MotorControl implementation
1323template <typename CommType>
1324bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::Enable() noexcept {
1325 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "MotorControl::Enable()");
1326
1327 // Enable via EN pin GPIO (EN is active LOW to enable, so set to ACTIVE/LOW to enable power stage)
1328 // This must be done first to enable the power stage
1329 driver_.comm_.GpioSet(TMC51x0CtrlPin::EN, GpioSignal::ACTIVE);
1330
1331 // Verify enable status by reading IOIN register (shows actual pin state as seen by TMC5160)
1332 uint32_t io_pins = 0;
1333 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::IOIN, io_pins, driver_.GetCommAddress())) {
1334 IOIN_Register ioin{};
1335 ioin.value = io_pins;
1336 bool drv_enn_high = (ioin.bits.drv_enn != 0);
1337 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "MotorControl::Enable",
1338 "IOIN Register: DRV_ENN=%s (Active LOW, %s)",
1339 drv_enn_high ? "HIGH" : "LOW",
1340 drv_enn_high ? "DISABLED" : "ENABLED");
1341 if (drv_enn_high) {
1342 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "MotorControl::Enable",
1343 "WARNING: DRV_ENN is HIGH after enable attempt. Driver power stage is DISABLED.");
1344 }
1345 } else {
1346 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "MotorControl::Enable", "Failed to read IOIN register to verify DRV_ENN status");
1347 }
1348
1349 // Enable via CHOPCONF register (set toff > 0)
1350 uint32_t chopconf_value = 0;
1351 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, chopconf_value)) {
1352 return false;
1353 }
1354 CHOPCONF_Register chopconf{};
1355 chopconf.value = chopconf_value;
1356 if (chopconf.bits.toff == 0) {
1357 // Restore saved toff value (default to 5 if not set)
1358 chopconf.bits.toff = 5;
1359 }
1360 return driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, chopconf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1361}
1362
1363template <typename CommType>
1364bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::Disable() noexcept {
1365 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "MotorControl::Disable()");
1366
1367 // Disable via CHOPCONF register (set toff = 0)
1368 uint32_t chopconf_value = 0;
1369 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, chopconf_value)) {
1370 return false;
1371 }
1372 CHOPCONF_Register chopconf{};
1373 chopconf.value = chopconf_value;
1374 chopconf.bits.toff = 0; // Disable driver
1375
1376 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, chopconf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1377
1378 // Disable via EN pin GPIO (EN is active LOW to enable, so set to INACTIVE/HIGH to disable power stage)
1379 driver_.comm_.GpioSet(TMC51x0CtrlPin::EN, GpioSignal::INACTIVE);
1380
1381 return success;
1382}
1383
1384template <typename CommType>
1385bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::SetCurrent(uint8_t irun, uint8_t ihold) noexcept {
1386 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "MotorControl::SetCurrent(irun=%u, ihold=%u)", irun, ihold);
1387
1388 // Use cached value from write_only_regs_ to preserve iholddelay (IHOLD_IRUN is write-only)
1389 IHOLD_IRUN_Register iholdrun{};
1390 iholdrun.value = driver_.write_only_regs_.ihold_irun;
1391
1392 // Update IRUN and IHOLD, preserve iholddelay
1393 iholdrun.bits.irun = constrain<decltype(irun)>(irun, 0U, 31U);
1394 iholdrun.bits.ihold = constrain<decltype(ihold)>(ihold, 0U, 31U);
1395 // iholddelay preserved from cached value
1396
1397 // Update cached values
1398 driver_.calculated_irun_ = iholdrun.bits.irun;
1399 driver_.calculated_ihold_ = iholdrun.bits.ihold;
1400
1401 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::IHOLD_IRUN, iholdrun.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1402 if (success) {
1403 driver_.write_only_regs_.ihold_irun = iholdrun.value;
1404 }
1405 return success;
1406}
1407
1408template <typename CommType>
1409bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::ConfigureChopper(const ChopperConfig& config) noexcept {
1410 // Update driver config
1411 driver_.driver_config_.chopper = config;
1412
1413 // Read-Modify-Write to preserve any fields not explicitly set in ChopperConfig
1414 uint32_t chopconf_val = 0;
1415 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, chopconf_val)) {
1416 return false;
1417 }
1418 CHOPCONF_Register chopconf{};
1419 chopconf.value = chopconf_val;
1420
1421 // Common fields
1422 chopconf.bits.toff = constrain<decltype(config.toff)>(config.toff, 0U, 15U);
1423 chopconf.bits.tbl = constrain<decltype(config.tbl)>(config.tbl, 0U, 3U);
1424 chopconf.bits.tpfd = constrain<decltype(config.tpfd)>(config.tpfd, 0U, 15U);
1425 chopconf.bits.mres = constrain<uint8_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(config.mres), 0U, 8U);
1426 chopconf.bits.intpol = config.intpol ? 1 : 0;
1427 chopconf.bits.dedge = config.dedge ? 1 : 0;
1428 chopconf.bits.vhighfs = config.vhighfs ? 1 : 0;
1429 chopconf.bits.vhighchm = config.vhighchm ? 1 : 0;
1430 chopconf.bits.diss2g = config.diss2g ? 1 : 0;
1431 chopconf.bits.diss2vs = config.diss2vs ? 1 : 0;
1432 // Note: Bit 17 is reserved per datasheet and is not used
1433
1434 // Mode-specific fields
1435 bool is_classic_mode = (config.mode == ChopperMode::CLASSIC);
1436 chopconf.bits.chm = is_classic_mode ? 1 : 0;
1437
1438 if (is_classic_mode) {
1439 // Classic mode: hstrt_tfd = TFD[2:0], hend_offset = OFFSET, tfd_3 = TFD[3], disfdcc
1440 uint8_t tfd_constrained = constrain<decltype(config.tfd)>(config.tfd, 0U, 15U);
1441 chopconf.bits.hstrt_tfd = tfd_constrained & 0x07; // Bits 2:0
1442 chopconf.bits.tfd_3 = (tfd_constrained >> 3) & 0x01; // Bit 3
1443 chopconf.bits.hend_offset = constrain<decltype(config.hend)>(config.hend, 0U, 15U); // OFFSET
1444 chopconf.bits.disfdcc = config.disfdcc ? 1 : 0;
1445 } else {
1446 // SpreadCycle mode: hstrt_tfd = HSTRT, hend_offset = HEND
1447 chopconf.bits.hstrt_tfd = constrain<decltype(config.hstrt)>(config.hstrt, 0U, 7U);
1448 chopconf.bits.hend_offset = constrain<decltype(config.hend)>(config.hend, 0U, 15U);
1449 chopconf.bits.tfd_3 = 0; // Reserved in SpreadCycle mode
1450 chopconf.bits.disfdcc = 0; // Not used in SpreadCycle mode
1451 }
1452
1453 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, chopconf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1454
1455 // Update stored microsteps
1456 if (success) {
1457 uint8_t mres = constrain<uint8_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(config.mres), 0U, 8U);
1458 driver_.current_microsteps_ = 256U >> mres;
1459 }
1460
1461 return success;
1462}
1463
1464template <typename CommType>
1465bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::ConfigureStealthChop(const StealthChopConfig& config) noexcept {
1466 // Update driver config
1467 driver_.driver_config_.stealthchop = config;
1468
1469 PWMCONF_Register pwmconf{};
1470 pwmconf.bits.pwm_ofs = config.pwm_ofs;
1471 pwmconf.bits.pwm_grad = config.pwm_grad;
1472 pwmconf.bits.pwm_freq = constrain<decltype(config.pwm_freq)>(config.pwm_freq, 0U, 3U);
1473 pwmconf.bits.pwm_autoscale = config.pwm_autoscale ? 1 : 0;
1474 pwmconf.bits.pwm_autograd = config.pwm_autograd ? 1 : 0;
1475 pwmconf.bits.pwm_reg = constrain<decltype(config.pwm_reg)>(config.pwm_reg, 0U, 15U);
1476 pwmconf.bits.pwm_lim = constrain<decltype(config.pwm_lim)>(config.pwm_lim, 0U, 15U);
1477 pwmconf.bits.freewheel = static_cast<uint8_t>(config.freewheel);
1478 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::PWMCONF, pwmconf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1479 if (success) {
1480 driver_.write_only_regs_.pwmconf = pwmconf.value;
1481 }
1482
1483 // Configure StealthChop velocity threshold (TPWMTHRS) if set
1484 if (success && config.velocity_threshold > 0.0F) {
1485 float steps_per_sec = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(config.velocity_threshold, config.velocity_threshold_unit);
1486 int32_t tpwmthrs = driver_.thresholdSpeedToTstep(steps_per_sec);
1487 tpwmthrs = std::min(tpwmthrs, static_cast<decltype(tpwmthrs)>(0xFFFFF)); // TPWMTHRS is 20 bits
1488 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Setting TPWMTHRS=%ld (%.2f %s)", tpwmthrs,
1489 config.velocity_threshold,
1490 (config.velocity_threshold_unit == Unit::Steps) ? "steps/s" : "units/s");
1491 success =
1492 driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::TPWMTHRS, static_cast<uint32_t>(tpwmthrs), driver_.GetCommAddress());
1493 if (success) {
1494 driver_.write_only_regs_.tpwmthrs = static_cast<uint32_t>(tpwmthrs);
1495 }
1496 }
1497
1498 return success;
1499}
1500
1501template <typename CommType>
1502bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::ConfigurePowerStage(const PowerStageParameters& config) noexcept {
1503 // Update driver config
1504 driver_.driver_config_.power_stage = config;
1505
1506 // Configure power stage (calculate register values from user-friendly parameters)
1507 DRV_CONF_Register drv_conf{};
1508
1509 // Calculate DRVSTRENGTH from MOSFET Miller charge
1510 float miller = config.mosfet_miller_charge_nc;
1511 if (miller < 0.0f) {
1512 miller = 0.0f; // Constrain to valid range
1513 }
1514 if (miller == 0.0f) {
1515 // Auto-calculate from default (small MOSFET, lowest driver strength)
1516 miller = 10.0f;
1517 }
1518
1519 uint8_t drv_strength = 0;
1520 // Auto-calculate from Miller charge (datasheet table 3.3)
1521 // Use lowest gate driver strength giving favorable switching slopes
1522 if (miller < 10.0f) {
1523 drv_strength = 0;
1524 } else if (miller < 20.0f) {
1525 drv_strength = 0; // Can use 0 or 1, prefer 0 (lowest) for best switching quality
1526 } else if (miller < 40.0f) {
1527 drv_strength = 1; // Can use 1 or 2, prefer 1 (lower)
1528 } else if (miller < 60.0f) {
1529 drv_strength = 2; // Can use 2 or 3, prefer 2 (lower)
1530 } else {
1531 drv_strength = 3; // Maximum for very large MOSFETs
1532 }
1533 drv_conf.bits.drvstrength = constrain<uint8_t>(drv_strength, 0U, 3U);
1534
1535 // Calculate BBMTIME and BBMCLKS from nanoseconds
1536 uint8_t bbm_time_reg = 0;
1537 uint8_t bbm_clks_reg = 0;
1538
1539 // Auto-calculate from bbm_time_ns
1540 uint32_t bbm_ns = config.bbm_time_ns;
1541
1542 if (bbm_ns == 0) {
1543 // Auto-calculate from MOSFET: use minimum safe time (100ns for small MOSFETs, lowest setting)
1544 // For larger MOSFETs with higher Miller charge, may need more time
1545 if (miller > 40.0f) {
1546 bbm_ns = 200; // Larger MOSFETs need more BBM time
1547 } else {
1548 bbm_ns = 100; // Default minimum (lowest, BBMTIME=0)
1549 }
1550 }
1551
1552 // Ensure minimum 100ns (lowest possible setting)
1553 if (bbm_ns < 100) {
1554 bbm_ns = 100;
1555 }
1556
1557 // BBMTIME calculation per datasheet:
1558 // Formula: time[ns] ≈ 100ns * 32 / (32 - BBMTIME)
1559 // Rearranged: BBMTIME = 32 - (100ns * 32 / time_ns)
1560 // BBMTIME range: 0-24 (bits 4..0)
1561 // BBMTIME=0 gives 100ns (shortest, reset default)
1562 // BBMTIME=16 gives 200ns
1563 // BBMTIME=24 gives ~375ns (longest, datasheet says 375ns, formula gives ~400ns)
1564 // >24 not recommended, use BBMCLKS instead
1565 //
1566 // Datasheet hint: Choose the lowest setting safely covering the switching event.
1567 // Add roughly 30% of reserve to cover production stray.
1568 if (bbm_ns <= 200) {
1569 // Use BBMTIME (0-24, corresponds to 100ns to ~375ns)
1570 // Add 30% headroom as recommended by datasheet (let user specify headroom percentage)
1571 float bbm_ns_with_headroom = static_cast<float>(bbm_ns) * 1.0f;
1572 // Calculate BBMTIME: BBMTIME = 32 - (100 * 32 / time_ns)
1573 float bbm_time_float = 32.0f - (100.0f * 32.0f / bbm_ns_with_headroom);
1574 bbm_time_reg = static_cast<uint8_t>(std::round(bbm_time_float));
1575 bbm_time_reg = constrain<uint8_t>(bbm_time_reg, 0U, 24U);
1576 bbm_clks_reg = 0; // BBMTIME takes precedence, BBMCLKS=0 (off)
1577 } else {
1578 // Use BBMCLKS for longer times (>200ns)
1579 // BBMCLKS range: 0-15 (bits 11..8), typ. 83ns per clock cycle at 12MHz
1580 // The longer setting rules (BBMTIME vs. BBMCLKS)
1581 // Add 30% headroom as recommended by datasheet
1582 float bbm_ns_with_headroom = static_cast<float>(bbm_ns) * 1.3f;
1583 // Calculate clock cycles: cycles = (time_ns * f_clk) / 1e9
1584 // At 12MHz: 1 cycle = 83.3ns
1585 uint32_t clock_cycles =
1586 static_cast<uint32_t>((bbm_ns_with_headroom * static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_)) / 1000000000.0f);
1587 bbm_clks_reg = constrain<uint8_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(clock_cycles), 0U, 15U);
1588 if (bbm_clks_reg == 0 && bbm_ns > 200) {
1589 bbm_clks_reg = 1; // Minimum 1 clock cycle if >200ns requested
1590 }
1591 bbm_time_reg = 0; // BBMCLKS takes precedence when set (longer setting rules)
1592 }
1593
1594 drv_conf.bits.bbmtime = bbm_time_reg;
1595 drv_conf.bits.bbmclks = bbm_clks_reg;
1596 drv_conf.bits.otselect = static_cast<uint8_t>(config.over_temp_protection);
1597 drv_conf.bits.filt_isense = static_cast<uint8_t>(config.sense_filter);
1598
1599 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(
1600 driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "Power stage: DRVSTRENGTH=%u (from %.1fnC), BBMTIME=%u, BBMCLKS=%u, FILT_ISENSE=%u",
1601 drv_conf.bits.drvstrength, miller, drv_conf.bits.bbmtime, drv_conf.bits.bbmclks, drv_conf.bits.filt_isense);
1602
1603 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::DRV_CONF, drv_conf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1604 if (success) {
1605 // Track write-only register
1606 driver_.write_only_regs_.drv_conf = drv_conf.value;
1607 }
1608 return success;
1609}
1610
1611template <typename CommType>
1612bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::ConfigureMotorCurrent(const MotorSpec& motor_spec) noexcept {
1613 // Validate inputs
1614 if (motor_spec.sense_resistor_mohm == 0 || motor_spec.supply_voltage_mv == 0) {
1615 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "TMC5160",
1616 "Cannot calculate motor current: sense_resistor_mohm=%u, supply_voltage_mv=%u",
1617 motor_spec.sense_resistor_mohm, motor_spec.supply_voltage_mv);
1618 return false;
1619 }
1620
1621 // Calculate motor current settings from physical parameters
1622 uint8_t calc_irun = 0;
1623 uint8_t calc_ihold = 0;
1624 uint16_t calc_scaler = 0;
1625
1626 uint16_t run_current = motor_spec.run_current_ma;
1627 if (run_current == 0) {
1628 run_current = motor_spec.rated_current_ma;
1629 }
1630 if (run_current == 0) {
1631 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "TMC5160", "Failed to calculate motor current: no current specified");
1632 return false;
1633 }
1634
1635 if (!CalculateMotorCurrent(motor_spec, motor_spec.sense_resistor_mohm, motor_spec.supply_voltage_mv, run_current,
1636 motor_spec.hold_current_ma, calc_irun, calc_ihold, calc_scaler)) {
1637 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "TMC5160", "Failed to calculate motor current settings");
1638 return false;
1639 }
1640
1641 // Apply percentage adjustments before constraining
1642 // GLOBAL_SCALER adjustment
1643 if (motor_spec.scaler_adjustment_percent != 0.0f) {
1644 float adjustment_factor = 1.0f + (motor_spec.scaler_adjustment_percent / 100.0f);
1645 calc_scaler = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::round(static_cast<float>(calc_scaler) * adjustment_factor));
1646 }
1647
1648 // IRUN adjustment
1649 if (motor_spec.irun_adjustment_percent != 0.0f) {
1650 float adjustment_factor = 1.0f + (motor_spec.irun_adjustment_percent / 100.0f);
1651 calc_irun = static_cast<uint8_t>(std::round(static_cast<float>(calc_irun) * adjustment_factor));
1652 }
1653
1654 // IHOLD adjustment
1655 if (motor_spec.ihold_adjustment_percent != 0.0f) {
1656 float adjustment_factor = 1.0f + (motor_spec.ihold_adjustment_percent / 100.0f);
1657 calc_ihold = static_cast<uint8_t>(std::round(static_cast<float>(calc_ihold) * adjustment_factor));
1658 }
1659
1660 // Constrain to valid ranges after adjustments
1661 calc_scaler = constrain<uint16_t>(calc_scaler, 32U, 256U);
1662 calc_irun = constrain<uint8_t>(calc_irun, 0U, 31U);
1663 calc_ihold = constrain<uint8_t>(calc_ihold, 0U, 31U);
1664
1665 // Ensure IHOLD < IRUN
1666 if (calc_ihold >= calc_irun) {
1667 calc_ihold = (calc_irun > 0) ? (calc_irun - 1) : 0;
1668 }
1669
1670 // Store calculated values internally
1671 driver_.calculated_irun_ = calc_irun;
1672 driver_.calculated_ihold_ = calc_ihold;
1673 driver_.calculated_global_scaler_ = calc_scaler;
1674
1675 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(
1676 driver_.comm_, 1, "TMC5160",
1677 "Calculated: IRUN=%u, IHOLD=%u, GLOBAL_SCALER=%u (adjustments: scaler=%.1f%%, irun=%.1f%%, ihold=%.1f%%)",
1678 calc_irun, calc_ihold, calc_scaler, motor_spec.scaler_adjustment_percent, motor_spec.irun_adjustment_percent,
1679 motor_spec.ihold_adjustment_percent);
1680
1681 // Configure global scaler (TMC5160 only, TMC5130 doesn't have this register)
1682 if (driver_.chip_version_ != ChipVersion::TMC5130) {
1683 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 3, "TMC5160", "Setting GLOBAL_SCALER=%u", calc_scaler);
1684 if (!driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::GLOBAL_SCALER, calc_scaler, driver_.GetCommAddress())) {
1685 return false;
1686 }
1687 // Update cache after successful write
1688 driver_.write_only_regs_.global_scaler = calc_scaler;
1689 driver_.calculated_global_scaler_ = calc_scaler;
1690 } else {
1691 // TMC5130: Skip GLOBAL_SCALER, use calculated IRUN directly
1692 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "TMC5130: Skipping GLOBAL_SCALER (not supported)");
1693 }
1694
1695 // Configure motor current (use calculated values)
1696 // Calculate IHOLDDELAY from total delay time, clock frequency, and current step count
1697 // IHOLDDELAY is delay PER current reduction step
1698 // Total delay = (IRUN - IHOLD) × IHOLDDELAY × (2^18 / f_clk)
1699 // Rearranged: IHOLDDELAY = (total_delay_ms / (IRUN - IHOLD)) × f_clk / (1000 × 2^18)
1700 uint8_t iholddelay_value = 0;
1701 if (motor_spec.iholddelay_ms > 0.0f) {
1702 uint8_t current_steps = (calc_irun > calc_ihold) ? (calc_irun - calc_ihold) : 0;
1703
1704 if (current_steps > 0) {
1705 // Calculate per-step delay from total delay
1706 float per_step_delay_ms = motor_spec.iholddelay_ms / static_cast<float>(current_steps);
1707 // Calculate IHOLDDELAY register value: delay_value = (per_step_delay_ms * f_clk) / (1000 * 2^18)
1708 // Where 2^18 = 262144
1709 float delay_clocks = (per_step_delay_ms * static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_)) / (1000.0f * 262144.0f);
1710 iholddelay_value = constrain<uint8_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(std::round(delay_clocks)), 0U, 15U);
1711
1712 // Calculate actual total delay for logging
1713 float actual_total_delay_ms = static_cast<float>(current_steps) * static_cast<float>(iholddelay_value) *
1714 (262144.0f * 1000.0f / static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_));
1715 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160",
1716 "IHOLDDELAY calculation: desired_total=%.2f ms, steps=%u, per_step=%.2f ms, IHOLDDELAY=%u, "
1717 "actual_total=%.2f ms",
1718 motor_spec.iholddelay_ms, current_steps, per_step_delay_ms, iholddelay_value,
1719 actual_total_delay_ms);
1720 } else {
1721 // IRUN == IHOLD, no current reduction steps, delay is always 0
1722 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160",
1723 "IHOLDDELAY ignored (IRUN=%u == IHOLD=%u, no current reduction steps)", calc_irun, calc_ihold);
1724 }
1725 }
1726 // else: iholddelay_value = 0 (instant power down)
1727
1728 IHOLD_IRUN_Register iholdrun{};
1729 iholdrun.bits.ihold = calc_ihold;
1730 iholdrun.bits.irun = calc_irun;
1731 iholdrun.bits.iholddelay = iholddelay_value;
1732 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 3, "TMC5160", "Setting IHOLD_IRUN(irun=%u, ihold=%u, iholddelay=%u)",
1733 iholdrun.bits.irun, iholdrun.bits.ihold, iholdrun.bits.iholddelay);
1734
1735 bool success = true;
1736 // Configure global scaler (TMC5160 only, TMC5130 doesn't have this register)
1737 if (driver_.chip_version_ != ChipVersion::TMC5130) {
1738 success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::GLOBAL_SCALER, calc_scaler, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1739 if (success) {
1740 driver_.write_only_regs_.global_scaler = calc_scaler;
1741 }
1742 } else {
1743 // TMC5130: Skip GLOBAL_SCALER, use calculated IRUN directly
1744 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160", "TMC5130: Skipping GLOBAL_SCALER (not supported)");
1745 }
1746 if (success) {
1747 success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::IHOLD_IRUN, iholdrun.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1748 if (success) {
1749 driver_.write_only_regs_.ihold_irun = iholdrun.value;
1750 }
1751 }
1752 return success;
1753}
1754
1755template <typename CommType>
1756bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::SetModeChangeSpeeds(float pwm_thrs, float cool_thrs, float high_thrs, Unit unit) noexcept {
1757 float pwm_steps = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(pwm_thrs, unit);
1758 float cool_steps = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(cool_thrs, unit);
1759 float high_steps = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(high_thrs, unit);
1760 int32_t tpwmthrs = driver_.thresholdSpeedToTstep(pwm_steps);
1761 int32_t tcoolthrs = driver_.thresholdSpeedToTstep(cool_steps);
1762 int32_t thigh = driver_.thresholdSpeedToTstep(high_steps);
1763 tpwmthrs = std::min(tpwmthrs, static_cast<decltype(tpwmthrs)>(0xFFFFF)); // 20 bits
1764 tcoolthrs = std::min(tcoolthrs, static_cast<decltype(tcoolthrs)>(0xFFFFF));
1765 thigh = std::min(thigh, static_cast<decltype(thigh)>(0xFFFFF));
1766 bool success = true;
1767 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::TPWMTHRS, static_cast<uint32_t>(tpwmthrs));
1768 if (success) {
1769 driver_.write_only_regs_.tpwmthrs = static_cast<uint32_t>(tpwmthrs);
1770 }
1771 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::TCOOLTHRS, static_cast<uint32_t>(tcoolthrs));
1772 if (success) {
1773 driver_.write_only_regs_.tcoolthrs = static_cast<uint32_t>(tcoolthrs);
1774 }
1775 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::THIGH, static_cast<uint32_t>(thigh));
1776 if (success) {
1777 driver_.write_only_regs_.thigh = static_cast<uint32_t>(thigh);
1778 }
1779 return success;
1780}

1823template <typename CommType>
1824bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::SetGlobalScaler(uint16_t scaler) noexcept {
1825 // TMC5130 doesn't support GLOBAL_SCALER register
1826 if (driver_.chip_version_ == ChipVersion::TMC5130) {
1827 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TMC5160", "TMC5130: GLOBAL_SCALER not supported, skipping");
1828 return true; // Return success but don't write
1829 }
1830 scaler = constrain<decltype(scaler)>(scaler, 32U, 256U);
1831 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::GLOBAL_SCALER, scaler, driver_.GetCommAddress());

1833 driver_.write_only_regs_.global_scaler = scaler;
1834 driver_.calculated_global_scaler_ = scaler;
1835 }
1836 return success;

1838
1839template <typename CommType>
1840bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::ConfigureCoolStep(const CoolStepConfig& config) noexcept {
1841 // Update driver config
1842 driver_.driver_config_.coolstep = config;
1843
1844 // Use cached value as COOLCONF is write-only
1845 COOLCONF_Register coolconf{};
1846 coolconf.value = driver_.write_only_regs_.coolconf;
1847
1848 // Preserve SGT (StallGuard2 threshold) - it's configured separately via StallGuardConfig
1849 // Only update CoolStep-specific fields
1850
1851 // Calculate SEMIN and SEMAX from user-friendly thresholds
1852 uint8_t semin = 0;
1853 uint8_t semax = 0;
1854
1855 if (config.lower_threshold_sg > 0) {
1856 // Convert SG threshold to SEMIN: threshold = SEMIN * 32
1857 // SEMIN = threshold / 32, clamped to 0-15
1858 semin = static_cast<uint8_t>(config.lower_threshold_sg / 32U);
1859 semin = constrain<decltype(semin)>(semin, 0U, 15U);
1860
1861 // Calculate SEMAX from upper threshold
1862 if (config.upper_threshold_sg > 0) {
1863 // Upper threshold = (SEMIN + SEMAX + 1) * 32
1864 // SEMAX = (upper_threshold / 32) - SEMIN - 1
1865 uint16_t upper_semin_equiv = static_cast<uint16_t>(config.upper_threshold_sg / 32U);
1866 if (upper_semin_equiv > semin) {
1867 semax = static_cast<uint8_t>(upper_semin_equiv - semin - 1U);
1868 semax = constrain<decltype(semax)>(semax, 0U, 15U);
1869 } else {
1870 // Upper threshold must be higher than lower threshold
1871 // If invalid, set semax to 0 (will use minimum hysteresis)
1872 semax = 0;
1873 }
1874 } else {
1875 // If upper threshold not specified, use default hysteresis
1876 // Default: semax = 5 (provides reasonable hysteresis gap)
1877 semax = 5;
1878 }
1879 }
1880 // If lower_threshold_sg = 0, semin = 0 (CoolStep disabled)
1881
1882 // Update CoolStep register fields
1883 coolconf.bits.semin = semin; // 0 = CoolStep disabled
1884 coolconf.bits.semax = semax;
1885
1886 // Convert increment step enum to register value
1887 coolconf.bits.seup = static_cast<uint8_t>(config.increment_step);
1888
1889 // Convert decrement speed enum to register value
1890 coolconf.bits.sedn = static_cast<uint8_t>(config.decrement_speed);
1891
1892 // Convert minimum current enum to register value
1893 coolconf.bits.seimin = (config.min_current == CoolStepMinCurrent::QUARTER_IRUN) ? 1 : 0;
1894
1895 // Update filter enable
1896 coolconf.bits.sfilt = config.enable_filter ? 1 : 0;
1897
1898 // Write COOLCONF register
1899 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::COOLCONF, coolconf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
1900 if (success) {
1901 driver_.write_only_regs_.coolconf = coolconf.value;
1902 }
1903
1904 // Configure velocity thresholds if provided
1905 if (success && config.min_velocity > 0.0F) {
1906 float steps_per_sec = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(config.min_velocity, config.velocity_unit);
1907 int32_t tcoolthrs = driver_.thresholdSpeedToTstep(steps_per_sec);
1908 tcoolthrs = std::min(tcoolthrs, static_cast<decltype(tcoolthrs)>(0xFFFFF)); // 20 bits
1909 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::TCOOLTHRS, static_cast<uint32_t>(tcoolthrs));
1910 if (success) {
1911 driver_.write_only_regs_.tcoolthrs = static_cast<uint32_t>(tcoolthrs);
1912 }
1913 }
1914
1915 if (success && config.max_velocity > 0.0F) {
1916 float steps_per_sec = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(config.max_velocity, config.velocity_unit);
1917 int32_t thigh = driver_.thresholdSpeedToTstep(steps_per_sec);
1918 thigh = std::min(thigh, static_cast<decltype(thigh)>(0xFFFFF)); // 20 bits
1919 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::THIGH, static_cast<uint32_t>(thigh));
1920 if (success) {
1921 driver_.write_only_regs_.thigh = static_cast<uint32_t>(thigh);
1922 }
1923 }
1924
1925 return success;
1926}
1927
1928template <typename CommType>
1929bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::ConfigureDcStep(const DcStepConfig& config) noexcept {
1930 // Update driver config
1931 driver_.driver_config_.dcstep = config;
1932
1933 // Convert velocity threshold to internal format with unit support
1934 int32_t vdc_min = 0;
1935 if (config.min_velocity > 0.0F) {
1936 float steps_per_sec = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(config.min_velocity, config.velocity_unit);
1937 vdc_min = driver_.speedToInternal(steps_per_sec);
1938 // VDCMIN is 23-bit register (0...2^22), but only bits 22..8 are used for comparison
1939 // Lower 8 bits (7..0) are ignored/unused by the hardware comparator.
1940 // We mask the value to 0x7FFF00 to explicitly zero out the unused bits,
1941 // ensuring the register value reflects the effective threshold.
1942 // Note: No shift is required; the register compares bits 22..8 of VDCMIN
1943 // against bits 22..8 of VACTUAL.
1944 vdc_min = vdc_min & 0x7FFF00;
1945 }
1946 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::VDCMIN, static_cast<uint32_t>(vdc_min));
1947 if (success) {
1948 driver_.write_only_regs_.vdcmin = static_cast<uint32_t>(vdc_min);
1949 }
1950 if (!success) {
1951 return false;
1952 }
1953
1954 // Calculate DC_TIME from PWM on-time (microseconds) or auto-calculate from blank time
1955 uint16_t dc_time = 0;
1956
1957 if (config.pwm_on_time_us > 0.0F) {
1958 // Convert microseconds to clock cycles: cycles = (time_us * f_clk) / 1e6
1959 float clock_cycles = (config.pwm_on_time_us * static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_)) / 1000000.0F;
1960 dc_time = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::round(clock_cycles));
1961 dc_time = constrain<decltype(dc_time)>(dc_time, 0U, 1023U);
1962 } else {
1963 // Auto-calculate from blank time (TBL) if not specified
1964 // Read current CHOPCONF to get TBL value
1965 uint32_t chopconf_value = 0;
1966 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, chopconf_value)) {
1967 CHOPCONF_Register chopconf{};
1968 chopconf.value = chopconf_value;
1969
1970 // TBL values: 0=16 clocks, 1=24 clocks, 2=36 clocks, 3=54 clocks
1971 uint8_t tbl_clocks[] = {16, 24, 36, 54};
1972 uint8_t tbl_index = constrain<uint8_t>(chopconf.bits.tbl, 0U, 3U);
1973 uint8_t blank_time_clocks = tbl_clocks[tbl_index];
1974
1975 // DC_TIME should be set slightly above blank time
1976 // Datasheet: Lower limit = TBL + n (where n = 1-100 for typical motor)
1977 // Use n = 20 as a reasonable default (provides margin without being too conservative)
1978 dc_time = blank_time_clocks + 20;
1979 dc_time = constrain<decltype(dc_time)>(dc_time, 0U, 1023U);
1980 } else {
1981 // If can't read CHOPCONF, use conservative default (36 clocks + 20 = 56)
1982 dc_time = 56;
1983 }
1984 }
1985
1986 // Calculate DC_SG from DC_TIME based on sensitivity
1987 uint8_t dc_sg = 0;
1988 if (config.stall_sensitivity != DcStepStallSensitivity::DISABLED && dc_time > 0) {
1989 // DC_SG should be set slightly higher than DC_TIME/16
1990 // Different sensitivity levels use different multipliers
1991 float dc_sg_float = 0.0F;
1992 switch (config.stall_sensitivity) {
1993 case DcStepStallSensitivity::LOW:
1994 dc_sg_float = static_cast<float>(dc_time) / 20.0F; // Less sensitive
1995 break;
1996 case DcStepStallSensitivity::MODERATE:
1997 dc_sg_float = static_cast<float>(dc_time) / 16.0F; // Recommended (datasheet default)
1998 break;
1999 case DcStepStallSensitivity::HIGH:
2000 dc_sg_float = static_cast<float>(dc_time) / 12.0F; // More sensitive
2001 break;
2002 default:
2003 dc_sg_float = 0.0F;
2004 break;
2005 }
2006 dc_sg = static_cast<uint8_t>(std::round(dc_sg_float));
2007 // Ensure minimum value of 1 if sensitivity is enabled
2008 if (dc_sg == 0 && config.stall_sensitivity != DcStepStallSensitivity::DISABLED) {
2009 dc_sg = 1;
2010 }
2011 dc_sg = constrain<decltype(dc_sg)>(dc_sg, 0U, 255U);
2012 }
2013
2014 // Configure DCCTRL register
2015 DCCTRL_Register dcctrl{};
2016 dcctrl.bits.dc_time = dc_time;
2017 dcctrl.bits.dc_sg = dc_sg;
2018 bool dcctrl_success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::DCCTRL, dcctrl.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2019 if (dcctrl_success) {
2020 driver_.write_only_regs_.dcctrl = dcctrl.value;
2021 }
2022 success &= dcctrl_success;
2023
2024 // Configure stop on stall if requested
2025 if (success && config.stop_on_stall && config.stall_sensitivity != DcStepStallSensitivity::DISABLED) {
2026 // Read current SW_MODE register
2027 uint32_t sw_mode_value = 0;
2028 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode_value)) {
2029 SW_MODE_Register sw_mode{};
2030 sw_mode.value = sw_mode_value;
2031 sw_mode.bits.sg_stop = 1; // Enable stop on stall
2032 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2033 }
2034 }
2035
2036 // Ensure CHOPCONF.vhighfs and CHOPCONF.vhighchm are set for DcStep
2037 // These flags switch to fullstepping when VDCMIN is exceeded
2038 // Note: These can also be set via ChopperConfig.vhighfs and ChopperConfig.vhighchm
2039 if (success && config.min_velocity > 0.0F) {
2040 uint32_t chopconf_value = 0;
2041 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, chopconf_value)) {
2042 CHOPCONF_Register chopconf{};
2043 chopconf.value = chopconf_value;
2044 chopconf.bits.vhighfs = 1; // Enable fullstepping at high velocity
2045 chopconf.bits.vhighchm = 1; // Enable chopper mode switching at high velocity
2046 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, chopconf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2047 }
2048 }
2049
2050 return success;
2051}

2053template <typename CommType>
2054bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::ConfigureGlobalConfig(const GlobalConfig& config) noexcept {
2055 // Update driver config
2056 driver_.driver_config_.global_config = config;
2057
2058 // Read-Modify-Write to preserve reserved bits (bits 18-31)
2059 uint32_t gconf_value = 0;

2061 return false;
2062 }
2063 GCONF_Register gconf{};
2064 gconf.value = gconf_value;
2065
2066 // Update only the configurable bits, preserving reserved bits
2067 gconf.bits.recalibrate = config.recalibrate ? 1 : 0;
2068 gconf.bits.faststandstill = config.en_short_standstill_timeout ? 1 : 0;
2069 gconf.bits.en_pwm_mode = config.en_stealthchop_mode ? 1 : 0;
2070 gconf.bits.multistep_filt = config.en_stealthchop_step_filter ? 1 : 0;
2071 gconf.bits.shaft = config.invert_direction ? 1 : 0;
2072 gconf.bits.diag0_error = config.diag0.error ? 1 : 0;
2073 gconf.bits.diag0_otpw = config.diag0.otpw ? 1 : 0;
2074 gconf.bits.diag0_stall_step = config.diag0.stall_step ? 1 : 0;
2075 gconf.bits.diag1_stall_dir = config.diag1.stall_dir ? 1 : 0;
2076 gconf.bits.diag1_index = config.diag1.index ? 1 : 0;
2077 gconf.bits.diag1_onstate = config.diag1.onstate ? 1 : 0;
2078 gconf.bits.diag1_steps_skipped = config.diag1.steps_skipped ? 1 : 0;
2079 gconf.bits.diag0_int_pushpull = config.diag0.pushpull ? 1 : 0;
2080 gconf.bits.diag1_poscomp_pushpull = config.diag1.pushpull ? 1 : 0;
2081 gconf.bits.small_hysteresis = config.en_small_step_frequency_hysteresis ? 1 : 0;
2082 gconf.bits.stop_enable = config.enca_dcin_sequencer_stop ? 1 : 0;
2083 gconf.bits.direct_mode = config.direct_mode ? 1 : 0;
2084 gconf.bits.test_mode = 0; // Always disabled (factory test mode, not for user)
2085 // Reserved bits (18-31) are preserved from read value
2086
2087 return driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::GCONF, gconf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2088}

2152template <typename CommType>
2153bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::IsStealthChopCalibrated() noexcept {
2154 uint8_t pwm_scale_sum = 0;
2155 int16_t pwm_scale_auto = 0;
2156 // Note: GetPwmScale is declared in MotorControl but implemented in Diagnostics
2157 // Using Diagnostics implementation for now
2158 if (!driver_.diagnostics.GetPwmScale(pwm_scale_sum, pwm_scale_auto)) {
2159 return false;
2160 }
2161 // StealthChop is calibrated if pwm_scale_auto is non-zero
2162 // pwm_scale_auto is a 9-bit signed value
2163 // Sign extend 9-bit to 16-bit for proper comparison
2164 if (pwm_scale_auto & 0x100) {
2165 pwm_scale_auto |= 0xFE00;
2166 }
2167 // Consider calibrated if value is not 0 and not in the very small range (-10 to 10)
2168 return (pwm_scale_auto != 0) && !(pwm_scale_auto > -10 && pwm_scale_auto < 10);
2169}

2171template <typename CommType>
2172bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::GetChopperConfig(ChopperConfig& config) noexcept {
2173 uint32_t value = 0;
2174 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::CHOPCONF, value)) {
2175 return false;
2176 }
2177 CHOPCONF_Register chopconf{};
2178 chopconf.value = value;
2179
2180 // Common fields
2181 config.toff = static_cast<uint8_t>(chopconf.bits.toff);
2182 config.tbl = static_cast<uint8_t>(chopconf.bits.tbl);
2183 config.tpfd = static_cast<uint8_t>(chopconf.bits.tpfd);
2184 config.mres = static_cast<MicrostepResolution>(chopconf.bits.mres);
2185 config.intpol = chopconf.bits.intpol != 0;
2186 config.dedge = chopconf.bits.dedge != 0;
2187 config.vhighfs = chopconf.bits.vhighfs != 0;
2188 config.vhighchm = chopconf.bits.vhighchm != 0;
2189 config.diss2g = chopconf.bits.diss2g != 0;
2190 config.diss2vs = chopconf.bits.diss2vs != 0;
2191
2192 // Mode-specific fields
2193 bool is_classic_mode = (chopconf.bits.chm != 0);
2194 config.mode = is_classic_mode ? ChopperMode::CLASSIC : ChopperMode::SPREAD_CYCLE;
2195
2196 if (is_classic_mode) {
2197 // Classic mode: reconstruct TFD from hstrt_tfd and tfd_3
2198 config.tfd = static_cast<uint8_t>(chopconf.bits.hstrt_tfd | (chopconf.bits.tfd_3 << 3));
2199 config.hend = static_cast<uint8_t>(chopconf.bits.hend_offset); // OFFSET
2200 config.disfdcc = chopconf.bits.disfdcc != 0;
2201 config.hstrt = 0; // Not used in Classic mode
2202 } else {
2203 // SpreadCycle mode
2204 config.hstrt = static_cast<uint8_t>(chopconf.bits.hstrt_tfd);
2205 config.hend = static_cast<uint8_t>(chopconf.bits.hend_offset);
2206 config.tfd = 0; // Not used in SpreadCycle mode
2207 config.disfdcc = false; // Not used in SpreadCycle mode
2208 }
2209
2210 return true;
2211}
