2285template <typename CommType>
2286bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::SetCoilCurrents(int16_t coil_a, int16_t coil_b) noexcept {
2287 // Constrain to valid 9-bit signed range (-256 to +255)
2288 // Datasheet recommends ±248 for safe operation in SpreadCycle mode
2289 coil_a = constrain<int16_t>(coil_a, -256, 255);
2290 coil_b = constrain<int16_t>(coil_b, -256, 255);
2291
2292 // Pack coil currents into XTARGET register:
2293 // - Bits 8..0: Coil A current (signed 9-bit)
2294 // - Bits 24..16: Coil B current (signed 9-bit)
2295 // Sign extend 9-bit values to 32-bit signed, then mask to 9 bits
2296 uint32_t xtarget = 0;
2297
2298 // Coil A: bits 8..0 (signed 9-bit)
2299 uint32_t coil_a_unsigned = static_cast<uint32_t>(coil_a) & 0x1FFU; // Mask to 9 bits
2300 xtarget |= coil_a_unsigned;
2301
2302 // Coil B: bits 24..16 (signed 9-bit)
2303 uint32_t coil_b_unsigned = static_cast<uint32_t>(coil_b) & 0x1FFU; // Mask to 9 bits
2304 xtarget |= (coil_b_unsigned << 16);
2305
2306 return driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::XTARGET, xtarget, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2307}
2308
2309template <typename CommType>
2310bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::SetIholdDelayMs(float total_delay_ms) noexcept {
2311 // Use cached value from write_only_regs_ (IHOLD_IRUN is write-only)
2312 IHOLD_IRUN_Register iholdrun{};
2313 iholdrun.value = driver_.write_only_regs_.ihold_irun;
2314
2315 if (total_delay_ms <= 0.0f) {
2316 // Setting to 0 or negative = instant power down (IHOLDDELAY = 0)
2317 iholdrun.bits.iholddelay = 0;
2318 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::IHOLD_IRUN, iholdrun.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2319 if (success) {
2320 driver_.write_only_regs_.ihold_irun = iholdrun.value;
2321 }
2322 return success;
2323 }
2324
2325 // Use cached IRUN and IHOLD to calculate current reduction steps
2326 uint8_t current_irun = iholdrun.bits.irun;
2327 uint8_t current_ihold = iholdrun.bits.ihold;
2328
2329 // Calculate number of current reduction steps
2330 uint8_t current_steps = (current_irun > current_ihold) ? (current_irun - current_ihold) : 0;
2331
2332 if (current_steps == 0) {
2333 // IRUN == IHOLD, no current reduction steps, delay is always 0
2334 iholdrun.bits.iholddelay = 0;
2335 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::IHOLD_IRUN, iholdrun.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2336 if (success) {
2337 driver_.write_only_regs_.ihold_irun = iholdrun.value;
2338 }
2339 return success;
2340 }
2341
2342 // Calculate per-step delay from total delay
2343 float per_step_delay_ms = total_delay_ms / static_cast<float>(current_steps);
2344
2345 // Calculate IHOLDDELAY register value: delay_value = (per_step_delay_ms * f_clk) / (1000 * 2^18)
2346 // Where 2^18 = 262144
2347 float delay_clocks = (per_step_delay_ms * static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_)) / (1000.0f * 262144.0f);
2348 uint8_t iholddelay_value = constrain<uint8_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(std::round(delay_clocks)), 0U, 15U);
2349
2350 // Update register
2351 iholdrun.bits.iholddelay = iholddelay_value;
2352 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::IHOLD_IRUN, iholdrun.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2353 if (success) {
2354 driver_.write_only_regs_.ihold_irun = iholdrun.value;
2355 }
2356 return success;
2357}

2360bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::SetMicrostepLookupTable(uint8_t index, uint32_t value) noexcept {

2365 Registers::MSLUT_4, Registers::MSLUT_5, Registers::MSLUT_6, Registers::MSLUT_7};

2369template <typename CommType>
2370bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::SetMicrostepLookupTableSegmentation(uint8_t width_sel_0, uint8_t width_sel_1,
2371 uint8_t width_sel_2, uint8_t width_sel_3,
2372 uint8_t lut_seg_start1,
2373 uint8_t lut_seg_start2,
2374 uint8_t lut_seg_start3) noexcept {
2375 MSLUTSEL_Register mslutsel{};
2376 mslutsel.bits.w0 = width_sel_0 & 0x3U; // Bits 1..0
2377 mslutsel.bits.w1 = width_sel_1 & 0x3U; // Bits 3..2
2378 mslutsel.bits.w2 = width_sel_2 & 0x3U; // Bits 5..4
2379 mslutsel.bits.w3 = width_sel_3 & 0x3U; // Bits 7..6
2380 mslutsel.bits.x1 = lut_seg_start1; // Bits 15..8
2381 mslutsel.bits.x2 = lut_seg_start2; // Bits 23..16
2382 mslutsel.bits.x3 = lut_seg_start3; // Bits 31..24
2383 return driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::MSLUTSEL, mslutsel.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2384}

2392template <typename CommType>
2393bool TMC51x0<CommType>::MotorControl::SetupMotorFromSpec(const MotorSpec& motor_spec,
2394 const MechanicalSystem* mechanical_system) noexcept {
2395 // Calculate global scaler based on rated current
2396 // Typical calculation: global_scaler = (rated_current_ma * 32) / (irun * sense_resistor_current)
2397 // For simplicity, we'll use a basic calculation
2398 uint16_t global_scaler = 32;
2399 if (motor_spec.rated_current_ma > 0) {
2400 // Basic calculation: assume 1.5A max current, scale accordingly
2401 global_scaler = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::min(256U, std::max(32U, (motor_spec.rated_current_ma * 32U) / 1500U)));
2402 }
2403
2404 // Set global scaler
2405 if (!SetGlobalScaler(global_scaler)) {
2406 return false;
2407 }
2408
2409 // Calculate irun and ihold from rated current
2410 // irun should be between 16-31 for best performance
2411 // We'll use 80% of rated current for irun, 30% for ihold
2412 uint8_t irun = 16;
2413 uint8_t ihold = 0;
2414 if (motor_spec.rated_current_ma > 0 && global_scaler > 0) {
2415 // Calculate irun: target current = (irun/32) * (global_scaler/32) * sense_resistor_current
2416 // Simplified: irun = (target_current * 32) / (global_scaler * sense_resistor_current / 32)
2417 // Assuming sense resistor gives ~1.5A at irun=31, global_scaler=32
2418 float target_run_current = static_cast<float>(motor_spec.rated_current_ma) * 0.8F;
2419 auto irun_calc =
2420 static_cast<uint32_t>((target_run_current * 32.0F) / (static_cast<float>(global_scaler) * 0.046875F));
2421 irun = static_cast<uint8_t>(std::min(static_cast<uint32_t>(31U), std::max(static_cast<uint32_t>(16U), irun_calc)));
2422 float target_hold_current = static_cast<float>(motor_spec.rated_current_ma) * 0.3F;
2423 auto ihold_calc =
2424 static_cast<uint32_t>((target_hold_current * 32.0F) / (static_cast<float>(global_scaler) * 0.046875F));
2425 ihold = static_cast<uint8_t>(std::min(static_cast<uint32_t>(31U), ihold_calc));
2426 }
2427
2428 // Set motor current
2429 if (!SetCurrent(irun, ihold)) {
2430 return false;
2431 }
2432
2433 // Configure chopper based on inductance if available
2434 if (motor_spec.winding_inductance_uh > 0) {
2435 ChopperConfig chop_config{};
2436 // Higher inductance may need different settings
2437 // This is a simplified heuristic
2438 if (motor_spec.winding_inductance_uh > 3000) {
2439 chop_config.tbl = 3; // Longer blank time for high inductance
2440 }
2441 ConfigureChopper(chop_config);
2442 }
2443
2444 // Note: mechanical_system is stored for unit conversions but not used here
2445 // as it's used by the unit conversion functions, not motor setup
2446
2447 return true;
2448}
2449
2450// Encoder implementation
2451template <typename CommType>
2452bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Encoder::Configure(const EncoderConfig& config) noexcept {
2453 // Update driver config
2454 driver_.driver_config_.encoder_config = config;
2455
2456 // Read-Modify-Write to preserve reserved bits (bits 11-31)
2457 uint32_t encmode_value = 0;
2458 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::ENCMODE, encmode_value)) {
2459 return false;
2460 }
2461 ENCMODE_Register encmode{};
2462 encmode.value = encmode_value;
2463
2464 // N channel active level (shares ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel enum)
2465 encmode.bits.pol_N = (config.n_channel_active == ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel::ACTIVE_HIGH) ? 1 : 0;
2466
2467 // A/B polarity requirements for N channel validation
2468 encmode.bits.pol_A = config.require_a_high ? 1 : 0;
2469 encmode.bits.pol_B = config.require_b_high ? 1 : 0;
2470 encmode.bits.ignore_AB = config.ignore_ab_polarity ? 1 : 0;
2471
2472 // Clear mode (clr_cont and clr_once are mutually exclusive)
2473 encmode.bits.clr_cont = (config.clear_mode == EncoderClearMode::CONTINUOUS) ? 1 : 0;
2474 encmode.bits.clr_once = (config.clear_mode == EncoderClearMode::ONCE) ? 1 : 0;
2475
2476 // N channel sensitivity (edge/level detection)
2477 // Register uses pos_edge (bit 6) and neg_edge (bit 7) as separate bits
2478 switch (config.n_sensitivity) {
2479 case EncoderNSensitivity::ACTIVE_LEVEL:
2480 encmode.bits.pos_edge = 0;
2481 encmode.bits.neg_edge = 0;
2482 break;
2483 case EncoderNSensitivity::RISING_EDGE:
2484 encmode.bits.pos_edge = 1;
2485 encmode.bits.neg_edge = 0;
2486 break;
2487 case EncoderNSensitivity::FALLING_EDGE:
2488 encmode.bits.pos_edge = 0;
2489 encmode.bits.neg_edge = 1;
2490 break;
2491 case EncoderNSensitivity::BOTH_EDGES:
2492 encmode.bits.pos_edge = 1;
2493 encmode.bits.neg_edge = 1;
2494 break;
2495 }
2496
2497 // Additional encoder features
2498 encmode.bits.clr_enc_x = config.clear_enc_x_on_event ? 1 : 0;
2499 encmode.bits.latch_x_act = config.latch_xactual_with_enc ? 1 : 0;
2500
2501 // Prescaler mode
2502 encmode.bits.enc_sel_decimal = (config.prescaler_mode == EncoderPrescalerMode::DECIMAL) ? 1 : 0;
2503 // Reserved bits (11-31) are preserved from read value
2504
2505 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::ENCMODE, encmode.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2506
2507 // Set encoder deviation if configured (must be done after Configure to ensure microsteps are set)
2508 if (success && config.allowed_deviation_steps > 0) {
2509 success = SetAllowedDeviation(config.allowed_deviation_steps);
2510 }
2511
2512 return success;
2513}
2514
2515template <typename CommType>
2516bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Encoder::GetEncoderConfig(EncoderConfig& config) noexcept {
2517 uint32_t encmode_val = 0;
2518 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::ENCMODE, encmode_val)) {
2519 return false;
2520 }
2521 ENCMODE_Register encmode{};
2522 encmode.value = encmode_val;
2523
2524 // Read N channel active level
2525 config.n_channel_active =
2526 (encmode.bits.pol_N != 0) ? ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel::ACTIVE_HIGH : ReferenceSwitchActiveLevel::ACTIVE_LOW;
2527
2528 // Read A/B polarity requirements
2529 config.require_a_high = (encmode.bits.pol_A != 0);
2530 config.require_b_high = (encmode.bits.pol_B != 0);
2531 config.ignore_ab_polarity = (encmode.bits.ignore_AB != 0);
2532
2533 // Read clear mode (clr_cont and clr_once are mutually exclusive)
2534 if (encmode.bits.clr_cont != 0) {
2535 config.clear_mode = EncoderClearMode::CONTINUOUS;
2536 } else if (encmode.bits.clr_once != 0) {
2537 config.clear_mode = EncoderClearMode::ONCE;
2538 } else {
2539 config.clear_mode = EncoderClearMode::DISABLED;
2540 }
2541
2542 // Read N channel sensitivity (pos_edge=bit6, neg_edge=bit7)
2543 if (encmode.bits.pos_edge == 0 && encmode.bits.neg_edge == 0) {
2544 config.n_sensitivity = EncoderNSensitivity::ACTIVE_LEVEL;
2545 } else if (encmode.bits.pos_edge == 1 && encmode.bits.neg_edge == 0) {
2546 config.n_sensitivity = EncoderNSensitivity::RISING_EDGE;
2547 } else if (encmode.bits.pos_edge == 0 && encmode.bits.neg_edge == 1) {
2548 config.n_sensitivity = EncoderNSensitivity::FALLING_EDGE;
2549 } else { // pos_edge == 1 && neg_edge == 1
2550 config.n_sensitivity = EncoderNSensitivity::BOTH_EDGES;
2551 }
2552
2553 // Read additional features
2554 config.clear_enc_x_on_event = (encmode.bits.clr_enc_x != 0);
2555 config.latch_xactual_with_enc = (encmode.bits.latch_x_act != 0);
2556
2557 // Read prescaler mode
2558 config.prescaler_mode =
2559 (encmode.bits.enc_sel_decimal != 0) ? EncoderPrescalerMode::DECIMAL : EncoderPrescalerMode::BINARY;
2560
2561 return true;
2562}

2614template <typename CommType>
2615bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Encoder::SetResolution(int32_t motor_steps, int32_t enc_resolution, bool inverted) noexcept {
2616 // Calculate factor: (motor_steps * microsteps) / enc_resolution
2617 // Use current microstep setting (may vary: 256, 128, 64, etc.)
2618 float factor = static_cast<float>(motor_steps * driver_.current_microsteps_) / static_cast<float>(enc_resolution);
2619
2620 // Check if binary prescaler gives exact match
2621 auto enc_const_binary = static_cast<int32_t>(factor * 65536.0F);
2622 if (enc_const_binary * enc_resolution == motor_steps * driver_.current_microsteps_ * 65536) {
2623 // Use binary mode
2624 uint32_t encmode_value = 0;
2625 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::ENCMODE, encmode_value)) {
2626 return false;
2627 }
2628 ENCMODE_Register encmode{};
2629 encmode.value = encmode_value;
2630 encmode.bits.enc_sel_decimal = false;
2631 if (!driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::ENCMODE, encmode.value)) {
2632 return false;
2633 }
2634 if (inverted) {
2635 enc_const_binary = -enc_const_binary;
2636 }
2637 uint32_t enc_const_value = static_cast<uint32_t>(enc_const_binary);
2638 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::ENC_CONST, enc_const_value);
2639 if (success) {
2640 driver_.write_only_regs_.enc_const = enc_const_value;
2641 }
2642 return success;
2643 }
2644 // Use decimal mode
2645 uint32_t encmode_value = 0;
2646 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::ENCMODE, encmode_value)) {
2647 return false;
2648 }
2649 ENCMODE_Register encmode{};
2650 encmode.value = encmode_value;
2651 encmode.bits.enc_sel_decimal = true;
2652 if (!driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::ENCMODE, encmode.value)) {
2653 return false;
2654 }
2655 int integer_part = static_cast<int>(std::floor(factor));
2656 int decimal_part = static_cast<int>((factor - static_cast<float>(integer_part)) * 10000.0F);
2657 if (inverted) {
2658 integer_part = 65535 - integer_part;
2659 decimal_part = 10000 - decimal_part;
2660 }
2661 int32_t enc_const_decimal = (integer_part * 65536) + decimal_part;
2662 bool exact_match = ((static_cast<int32_t>(factor * 10000.0F) * enc_resolution) ==
2663 (motor_steps * driver_.current_microsteps_ * 10000));
2664 uint32_t enc_const_value = static_cast<uint32_t>(enc_const_decimal);
2665 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::ENC_CONST, enc_const_value);
2666 if (success) {
2667 driver_.write_only_regs_.enc_const = enc_const_value;
2668 }
2669 return exact_match && success;
2670}

2672template <typename CommType>
2673bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Encoder::SetAllowedDeviation(int32_t steps) noexcept {
2674 // Convert steps to microsteps using current microstep setting
2675 int32_t deviation = steps * driver_.current_microsteps_;
2676 deviation = std::min(deviation, static_cast<int32_t>(0xFFFFF)); // 20 bits
2677 uint32_t deviation_value = static_cast<uint32_t>(deviation);
2678 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::ENC_DEVIATION, deviation_value);
2679 if (success) {
2680 driver_.write_only_regs_.enc_deviation = deviation_value;
2681 }
2682 return success;
2683}

2713// Diagnostics implementation
2714template <typename CommType>
2715DriverStatus TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::GetStatus() noexcept {
2716 uint32_t gstat_value = 0;
2717 uint32_t drv_status_value = 0;
2718 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::GSTAT, gstat_value)) {
2719 return DriverStatus::OTHER_ERR;
2720 }
2721 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::DRV_STATUS, drv_status_value)) {
2722 return DriverStatus::OTHER_ERR;
2723 }
2724
2725 GSTAT_Register gstat{};
2726 gstat.value = gstat_value;
2727 DRV_STATUS_Register drv_status{};
2728 drv_status.value = drv_status_value;
2729
2730 if (gstat.bits.uv_cp) {
2731 return DriverStatus::CP_UV;
2732 }
2733 if (drv_status.bits.s2vsa) {
2734 return DriverStatus::S2VSA;
2735 }
2736 if (drv_status.bits.s2vsb) {
2737 return DriverStatus::S2VSB;
2738 }
2739 if (drv_status.bits.s2ga) {
2740 return DriverStatus::S2GA;
2741 }
2742 if (drv_status.bits.s2gb) {
2743 return DriverStatus::S2GB;
2744 }
2745 if (drv_status.bits.ot) {
2746 return DriverStatus::OT;
2747 }
2748 if (gstat.bits.drv_err) {
2749 return DriverStatus::OTHER_ERR;
2750 }
2751 if (drv_status.bits.otpw) {
2752 return DriverStatus::OTPW;
2753 }
2754
2755 return DriverStatus::OK;
2756}

2796template <typename CommType>
2797bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::ConfigureStallGuard(const StallGuardConfig& config) noexcept {
2798 // Update driver config
2799 driver_.driver_config_.stallguard = config;
2800
2801 // Use cached value as COOLCONF is write-only
2802 COOLCONF_Register coolconf{};
2803 coolconf.value = driver_.write_only_regs_.coolconf;
2804
2805 // SGT is signed 7-bit (-64 to +63), constrain and mask to 7 bits (bits 22..16)
2806 auto sgt_signed = static_cast<int8_t>(constrain<int8_t>(config.threshold, -64, 63));
2807 coolconf.bits.sgt = static_cast<int32_t>(sgt_signed) & 0x7F;
2808
2809 // Update filter enable
2810 coolconf.bits.sfilt = config.enable_filter ? 1 : 0;
2811
2812 // Preserve CoolStep fields (semin, seup, semax, sedn, seimin)
2813 // They are already in coolconf.value from ReadRegister
2814
2815 // Write COOLCONF register
2816 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::COOLCONF, coolconf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2817 if (success) {
2818 driver_.write_only_regs_.coolconf = coolconf.value;
2819 }
2820
2821 // Configure velocity thresholds if provided
2822 if (success && config.min_velocity > 0.0F) {
2823 float steps_per_sec = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(config.min_velocity, config.velocity_unit);
2824 int32_t tcoolthrs = driver_.thresholdSpeedToTstep(steps_per_sec);
2825 tcoolthrs = std::min(tcoolthrs, static_cast<decltype(tcoolthrs)>(0xFFFFF)); // 20 bits
2826 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::TCOOLTHRS, static_cast<uint32_t>(tcoolthrs));
2827 if (success) {
2828 driver_.write_only_regs_.tcoolthrs = static_cast<uint32_t>(tcoolthrs);
2829 }
2830 }
2831
2832 if (success && config.max_velocity > 0.0F) {
2833 float steps_per_sec = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(config.max_velocity, config.velocity_unit);
2834 int32_t thigh = driver_.thresholdSpeedToTstep(steps_per_sec);
2835 thigh = std::min(thigh, static_cast<decltype(thigh)>(0xFFFFF)); // 20 bits
2836 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::THIGH, static_cast<uint32_t>(thigh));
2837 if (success) {
2838 driver_.write_only_regs_.thigh = static_cast<uint32_t>(thigh);
2839 }
2840 }
2841
2842 // Configure stop on stall if requested
2843 if (success && config.stop_on_stall) {
2844 uint32_t sw_mode_value = 0;
2845 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode_value)) {
2846 SW_MODE_Register sw_mode{};
2847 sw_mode.value = sw_mode_value;
2848 sw_mode.bits.sg_stop = 1; // Enable stop on stall
2849 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
2850 }
2851 }
2852
2853 return success;
2854}

2971template <typename CommType>
2972bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::SetTcoolthrs(float threshold, Unit unit) noexcept {
2973 if (threshold < 0.0F) {
2974 return false;
2975 }
2976
2977 float steps_per_sec = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(threshold, unit);
2978 int32_t tcoolthrs = driver_.thresholdSpeedToTstep(steps_per_sec);
2979 tcoolthrs = std::min(tcoolthrs, static_cast<int32_t>(0xFFFFF)); // 20 bits
2980
2981 bool success =
2982 driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::TCOOLTHRS, static_cast<uint32_t>(tcoolthrs), driver_.GetCommAddress());
2983 if (success) {
2984 driver_.write_only_regs_.tcoolthrs = static_cast<uint32_t>(tcoolthrs);
2985 }
2986 return success;
2987}
2988
2989template <typename CommType>
2990bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::GetTcoolthrs(float& threshold, Unit unit) const noexcept {
2991 uint32_t tcoolthrs = driver_.write_only_regs_.tcoolthrs;
2992 // Convert TSTEP value back to speed: fSTEP = f_CLK / (TSTEP * USC)
2993 // TCOOLTHRS is in TSTEP units (20 bits), where TSTEP = f_CLK / (fSTEP * USC)
2994 // So fSTEP = f_CLK / (TCOOLTHRS * USC)
2995 // For threshold, we use the same conversion as thresholdSpeedToTstep but in reverse
2996 if (tcoolthrs == 0) {
2997 threshold = 0.0f; // 0 means disabled (infinite threshold)
2998 } else {
2999 float f_clk = static_cast<float>(driver_.f_clk_);
3000 float current_microsteps = static_cast<float>(driver_.current_microsteps_);
3001 float steps_per_sec = f_clk / (static_cast<float>(tcoolthrs) * current_microsteps);
3002 threshold = driver_.convertSpeedToUnit(steps_per_sec, unit);
3003 }
3004 return true;
3005}

3014 return true;
3015}
3016
3017template <typename CommType>
3018bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Homing::CacheCurrentSettings() noexcept {
3019 cache_.is_valid = false;
3020
3021 // Cache StealthChop state
3022 cache_.cached_stealthchop_enabled = driver_.motorControl.IsStealthChopEnabled();
3023 cache_.stealthchop_was_modified = false; // Will be set if we modify it
3024
3025 // Cache SW_MODE register
3026 uint32_t sw_mode_value = 0;
3027 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode_value)) {
3028 return false;
3029 }
3030 cache_.cached_sw_mode.value = sw_mode_value;
3031 cache_.sw_mode_was_modified = false; // Will be set if we modify it
3032
3033 // Cache ramp settings - read from registers
3034 uint32_t ramp_mode_val = 0;
3035 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::RAMPMODE, ramp_mode_val)) {
3036 cache_.cached_ramp_mode = static_cast<RampMode>(ramp_mode_val);
3037 }
3038
3039 // Use cached values as VMAX, AMAX, DMAX, VSTART, VSTOP are write-only registers
3040 if (driver_.write_only_regs_.vmax > 0) {
3041 cache_.cached_max_speed = driver_.speedFromInternal(static_cast<int32_t>(driver_.write_only_regs_.vmax));
3042 } else {
3043 cache_.cached_max_speed = 0.0f;
3044 }
3045
3046 if (driver_.write_only_regs_.amax > 0) {
3047 // Convert from internal units (Hz) to steps/s²
3048 // Internal: accel = (2^24) / (256 * accel_internal)
3049 // Reverse: accel_internal = (2^24) / (256 * accel)
3050 // So: accel = (2^24) / (256 * accel_internal)
3051 cache_.cached_acceleration = static_cast<float>(16777216.0 / (256.0 * static_cast<double>(driver_.write_only_regs_.amax)));
3052 } else {
3053 cache_.cached_acceleration = 0.0f;
3054 }
3055
3056 if (driver_.write_only_regs_.dmax > 0) {
3057 // Convert from internal units (Hz) to steps/s²
3058 cache_.cached_deceleration = static_cast<float>(16777216.0 / (256.0 * static_cast<double>(driver_.write_only_regs_.dmax)));
3059 } else {
3060 cache_.cached_deceleration = 0.0f;
3061 }
3062
3063 if (driver_.write_only_regs_.vstart > 0) {
3064 cache_.cached_vstart = driver_.speedFromInternal(static_cast<int32_t>(driver_.write_only_regs_.vstart));
3065 } else {
3066 cache_.cached_vstart = 0.0f;
3067 }
3068
3069 if (driver_.write_only_regs_.vstop > 0) {
3070 cache_.cached_vstop = driver_.speedFromInternal(static_cast<int32_t>(driver_.write_only_regs_.vstop));
3071 } else {
3072 cache_.cached_vstop = 0.0f;
3073 }
3074
3075 cache_.ramp_settings_were_modified = false; // Will be set if we modify them
3076 cache_.is_valid = true;
3077 return true;
3078}
3079
3080template <typename CommType>
3081bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Homing::RestoreCachedSettings() noexcept {
3082 if (!cache_.is_valid) {
3083 return false;
3084 }
3085
3086 bool success = true;
3087
3088 // Restore StealthChop state (if it was modified)
3089 if (cache_.stealthchop_was_modified) {
3090 success &= driver_.motorControl.SetStealthChopEnabled(cache_.cached_stealthchop_enabled);
3091 }
3092
3093 // Restore SW_MODE register (if it was modified)
3094 if (cache_.sw_mode_was_modified) {
3095 success &= driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, cache_.cached_sw_mode.value);
3096 }
3097
3098 // Restore ramp settings (if they were modified)
3099 if (cache_.ramp_settings_were_modified) {
3100 success &= driver_.rampControl.SetRampMode(cache_.cached_ramp_mode);
3101 success &= driver_.rampControl.SetMaxSpeed(cache_.cached_max_speed);
3102 success &= driver_.rampControl.SetAcceleration(cache_.cached_acceleration);
3103 success &= driver_.rampControl.SetDeceleration(cache_.cached_deceleration);
3104 success &= driver_.rampControl.SetRampSpeeds(cache_.cached_vstart, cache_.cached_vstop, 0.0f, Unit::Steps);
3105 }
3106
3107 return success;
3108}
3109
3110template <typename CommType>
3111bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Homing::EnsureSpreadCycleForStallGuard() noexcept {
3112 // Check if StealthChop is enabled
3113 if (driver_.motorControl.IsStealthChopEnabled()) {
3114 // Cache the state and disable StealthChop (StallGuard requires SpreadCycle)
3115 cache_.cached_stealthchop_enabled = true;
3116 cache_.stealthchop_was_modified = true;
3117 return driver_.motorControl.SetStealthChopEnabled(false);
3118 }
3119 return true; // Already in SpreadCycle mode
3120}
3121
3122template <typename CommType>
3123bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Homing::PerformSensorlessHoming(bool direction, float search_speed,
3124 int32_t& final_position, uint32_t timeout_ms) noexcept {
3125 // Cache current settings
3126 if (!CacheCurrentSettings()) {
3127 return false;
3128 }
3129
3130 // Ensure SpreadCycle mode for StallGuard (disable StealthChop if enabled)
3131 if (!EnsureSpreadCycleForStallGuard()) {
3132 return false;
3133 }
3134
3135 // Use existing StallGuard configuration (SGT threshold from motor config)
3136 // Do NOT reconfigure StallGuard - use the existing SGT value
3137
3138 // Enable StallGuard2 stop in SW_MODE
3139 SW_MODE_Register sw_mode{};
3140 sw_mode.value = cache_.cached_sw_mode.value;
3141 sw_mode.bits.sg_stop = true; // Enable stop on stall
3142 sw_mode.bits.en_softstop = false; // Use hard stop for precise homing (per datasheet 12.4)
3143 if (!driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode.value)) {
3144 RestoreCachedSettings();
3145 return false;
3146 }
3147 cache_.sw_mode_was_modified = true;
3148
3149 // Clear any existing stall flags
3150 uint32_t ramp_stat_dummy = 0;
3151 driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::RAMP_STAT, ramp_stat_dummy);
3152 // Write back 1 to event_stop_sg to clear it
3153 RAMP_STAT_Register clear_stat{};
3154 clear_stat.bits.event_stop_sg = 1;
3155 driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::RAMP_STAT, clear_stat.value);
3156
3157 // Set velocity mode and start movement
3158 RampMode mode = direction ? RampMode::VELOCITY_POS : RampMode::VELOCITY_NEG;
3159 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetRampMode(mode)) {
3160 RestoreCachedSettings();
3161 return false;
3162 }
3163 cache_.ramp_settings_were_modified = true;
3164
3165 // CRITICAL: Set acceleration/deceleration BEFORE setting speeds
3166 // Velocity mode requires AMAX > 0 to actually accelerate from VSTART to VMAX
3167 // Use reasonable acceleration: reach VMAX in ~0.1 seconds
3168 float acceleration = std::max(search_speed * 10.0f, 50000.0f); // At least 50k steps/s²
3169 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetAcceleration(acceleration)) {
3170 RestoreCachedSettings();
3171 return false;
3172 }
3173 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetDeceleration(acceleration)) {
3174 RestoreCachedSettings();
3175 return false;
3176 }
3177
3178 // Set VSTART > 0 to actually start motion in velocity mode
3179 // VSTART should be reasonable but less than VMAX - use 10% of search speed or minimum 1000 steps/s
3180 float vstart_speed = std::max(search_speed * 0.1f, 1000.0f);
3181 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetRampSpeeds(vstart_speed, 100.0f, 0.0f, Unit::Steps)) {
3182 RestoreCachedSettings();
3183 return false;
3184 }
3185 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetMaxSpeed(search_speed)) {
3186 RestoreCachedSettings();
3187 return false;
3188 }
3189
3190 // Wait for stall event
3191 bool stalled = false;
3192 // Simple polling loop with crude timeout using rough cycle estimates
3193 // Assuming ~10us per register read interaction on SPI
3194 uint32_t loops = timeout_ms * 100;
3195
3196 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < loops; i++) {
3197 uint32_t ramp_stat = 0;
3198 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::RAMP_STAT, ramp_stat)) {
3199 RAMP_STAT_Register status{};
3200 status.value = ramp_stat;
3201
3202 // Check for stall stop event or velocity zero (stop executed)
3203 if (status.bits.event_stop_sg || (status.bits.vzero && status.bits.status_sg)) {
3204 stalled = true;
3205 break;
3206 }
3207 }
3208 // Small delay to relieve bus
3209 // driver_.comm_.DelayUs(100); // Requires DelayUs in Comm interface, assuming it exists
3210 }
3211
3212 // Stop motor (ensure VMAX=0)
3213 driver_.rampControl.Stop();
3214
3215 // Disable StallGuard2 stop to prevent accidental stops later
3216 sw_mode.bits.sg_stop = false;
3217 driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode.value);
3218
3219 // Read final position
3220 float final_pos_float = 0.0f;
3221 if (driver_.rampControl.GetCurrentPosition(final_pos_float, Unit::Steps)) {
3222 final_position = static_cast<int32_t>(final_pos_float);
3223 }
3224
3225 // Clear the stall event flag again to be clean
3226 driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::RAMP_STAT, clear_stat.value);
3227
3228 // Restore cached settings before returning
3229 RestoreCachedSettings();
3230
3231 return stalled;
3232}
3233
3234template <typename CommType>
3235bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Homing::PerformSwitchHoming(bool direction, float search_speed, float switch_speed,
3236 int32_t& final_position, bool use_left_switch,
3237 uint32_t timeout_ms) noexcept {
3238 // Cache current settings
3239 if (!CacheCurrentSettings()) {
3240 return false;
3241 }
3242
3243 // Complete homing procedure per datasheet section 12.4:
3244 // Step 1: Make sure switch is not pressed (move away from switch)
3245 // This is user responsibility - we assume switch is not pressed at start
3246
3247 // Step 2: Activate position latching and motor stop upon switch event
3248 SW_MODE_Register sw_mode{};
3249 sw_mode.value = cache_.cached_sw_mode.value;
3250
3251 // Configure latching and stop enable based on switch choice
3252 // Note: This assumes switch is already configured via ConfigureReferenceSwitch
3253 // We're just enabling latching and stop for the homing procedure
3254 if (use_left_switch) {
3255 sw_mode.bits.latch_l_active = true; // Latch on active edge for homing
3256 sw_mode.bits.stop_l_enable = true; // Enable stop on left switch
3257 } else {
3258 sw_mode.bits.latch_r_active = true; // Latch on active edge for homing
3259 sw_mode.bits.stop_r_enable = true; // Enable stop on right switch
3260 }
3261 // Use hard stop for precise homing (per datasheet 12.4 recommendation)
3262 // Hard stop ensures motor stops exactly at switch position (no overshoot)
3263 sw_mode.bits.en_softstop = false;
3264
3265 if (!driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode.value)) {
3266 RestoreCachedSettings();
3267 return false;
3268 }
3269 cache_.sw_mode_was_modified = true;
3270
3271 // Step 3: Start motion ramp into direction of switch
3272 // Move to a more negative position for left switch, more positive for right switch
3273 RampMode mode = direction ? RampMode::VELOCITY_POS : RampMode::VELOCITY_NEG;
3274 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetRampMode(mode)) {
3275 RestoreCachedSettings();
3276 return false;
3277 }
3278 cache_.ramp_settings_were_modified = true;
3279
3280 // Set acceleration before speed (required for velocity mode)
3281 float acceleration = std::max(search_speed * 10.0f, 50000.0f); // At least 50k steps/s²
3282 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetAcceleration(acceleration)) {
3283 RestoreCachedSettings();
3284 return false;
3285 }
3286 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetDeceleration(acceleration)) {
3287 RestoreCachedSettings();
3288 return false;
3289 }
3290
3291 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetMaxSpeed(search_speed)) {
3292 RestoreCachedSettings();
3293 return false;
3294 }
3295
3296 // Step 3 (continued): Wait for switch hit (motor stops automatically)
3297 bool switch_hit = false;
3298 uint32_t loops = timeout_ms * 100; // 10ms per loop
3299 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < loops; i++) {
3300 uint32_t ramp_stat = 0;
3301 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::RAMP_STAT, ramp_stat)) {
3302 RAMP_STAT_Register status{};
3303 status.value = ramp_stat;
3304
3305 // Check for specific stop event
3306 if ((use_left_switch && status.bits.event_stop_l) || (!use_left_switch && status.bits.event_stop_r)) {
3307 switch_hit = true;
3308 break;
3309 }
3310 // Also check vzero if we missed the event flag but stopped
3311 if (status.bits.vzero &&
3312 ((use_left_switch && status.bits.status_stop_l) || (!use_left_switch && status.bits.status_stop_r))) {
3313 switch_hit = true;
3314 break;
3315 }
3316 }
3317 // Small delay for polling (10ms)
3318 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(10);
3319 }
3320
3321 // Ensure motor is stopped
3322 driver_.rampControl.Stop();
3323
3324 if (!switch_hit) {
3325 // Timeout - disable stop function and return
3326 if (use_left_switch) {
3327 sw_mode.bits.stop_l_enable = false;
3328 } else {
3329 sw_mode.bits.stop_r_enable = false;
3330 }
3331 driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode.value);
3332 RestoreCachedSettings();
3333 return false;
3334 }
3335
3336 // Step 4: Wait until motor is in standstill (poll VACTUAL or check vzero/standstill flag)
3337 // Per datasheet: "Wait until the motor is in standstill again by polling the actual velocity
3338 // VACTUAL or checking vzero or the standstill flag"
3339 uint32_t standstill_loops = 0;
3340 const uint32_t max_standstill_loops = 1000; // 10 seconds max wait
3341 bool in_standstill = false;
3342
3343 while (standstill_loops < max_standstill_loops) {
3344 uint32_t ramp_stat = 0;
3345 if (driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::RAMP_STAT, ramp_stat)) {
3346 RAMP_STAT_Register status{};
3347 status.value = ramp_stat;
3348
3349 // Check vzero flag (velocity reached zero)
3350 if (status.bits.vzero) {
3351 // Also verify VACTUAL is near zero
3352 float vactual = 0.0f;
3353 if (driver_.rampControl.GetCurrentSpeed(vactual, Unit::Steps) &&
3354 std::abs(vactual) < 1.0f) { // Less than 1 step/s
3355 in_standstill = true;
3356 break;
3357 }
3358 }
3359 }
3360 standstill_loops++;
3361 // Small delay for polling (10ms)
3362 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(10);
3363 }
3364
3365 if (!in_standstill) {
3366 // Motor didn't reach standstill - disable stop and return error
3367 if (use_left_switch) {
3368 sw_mode.bits.stop_l_enable = false;
3369 } else {
3370 sw_mode.bits.stop_r_enable = false;
3371 }
3372 driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode.value);
3373 RestoreCachedSettings();
3374 return false;
3375 }
3376
3377 // Step 5: Switch to hold mode and calculate difference between latched and actual position
3378 // Per datasheet: "Switch the ramp generator to hold mode and calculate the difference
3379 // between the latched position and the actual position. For StallGuard based homing or
3380 // when using hard stop, XACTUAL stops exactly at the home position, so there is no difference (0)."
3381
3382 // Switch to hold mode
3383 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetRampMode(RampMode::HOLD)) {
3384 RestoreCachedSettings();
3385 return false;
3386 }
3387
3388 // Read latched position (XLATCH) - captured at switch hit
3389 float latched_pos_float = 0.0f;
3390 int32_t latched_position = 0;
3391 if (driver_.rampControl.GetLatchedPosition(latched_pos_float, Unit::Steps)) {
3392 latched_position = static_cast<int32_t>(latched_pos_float);
3393 }
3394
3395 // Read actual position (XACTUAL) - current motor position
3396 float actual_pos_float = 0.0f;
3397 int32_t actual_position = 0;
3398 if (driver_.rampControl.GetCurrentPosition(actual_pos_float, Unit::Steps)) {
3399 actual_position = static_cast<int32_t>(actual_pos_float);
3400 }
3401
3402 // Calculate difference
3403 // With hard stop, XACTUAL stops exactly at switch position, so XLATCH ≈ XACTUAL
3404 // The difference represents any offset between latched and actual position
3405 int32_t position_difference = latched_position - actual_position;
3406
3407 // Step 6: Write the calculated difference into the actual position register
3408 // Per datasheet: "Write the calculated difference into the actual position register.
3409 // Now, homing is finished. A move to position 0 will bring back the motor exactly to the switching point."
3410 //
3411 // To make the switch position = home (0):
3412 // - Current: XACTUAL = switch_position, XLATCH = switch_position (captured)
3413 // - Goal: When motor is at switch, XACTUAL = 0
3414 // - Solution: Set XACTUAL = XACTUAL - latched_position
3415 // This makes: new_XACTUAL = switch_position - switch_position = 0
3416 // And latched position becomes: XLATCH - (switch_position - switch_position) = 0
3417 //
3418 // With hard stop, difference should be ~0, so this is effectively setting XACTUAL = 0
3419 int32_t new_position = actual_position - latched_position;
3420 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetCurrentPosition(static_cast<float>(new_position), Unit::Steps, false)) {
3421 RestoreCachedSettings();
3422 return false;
3423 }
3424
3425 // Return final position (should be 0 after homing, representing home position)
3426 float final_pos_float = 0.0f;
3427 if (driver_.rampControl.GetCurrentPosition(final_pos_float, Unit::Steps)) {
3428 final_position = static_cast<int32_t>(final_pos_float);
3429 }
3430
3431 // Disable stop function to allow moving away from switch
3432 if (use_left_switch) {
3433 sw_mode.bits.stop_l_enable = false;
3434 sw_mode.bits.latch_l_active = false;
3435 } else {
3436 sw_mode.bits.stop_r_enable = false;
3437 sw_mode.bits.latch_r_active = false;
3438 }
3439 driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SW_MODE, sw_mode.value);
3440
3441 // Restore cached settings before returning
3442 RestoreCachedSettings();
3443
3444 return true;
3445}

3447// Communication implementation
3448template <typename CommType>
3449bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Communication::ConfigureUartNodeAddress(uint8_t node_address, uint8_t send_delay) noexcept {
3450 SLAVECONF_Register slaveconf{};
3451 slaveconf.bits.slaveaddr = node_address & 0xFF; // Address range is 0-254 (8-bit)
3452 slaveconf.bits.senddelay = constrain<uint8_t>(send_delay, 0U, 15U);
3453
3454 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SLAVECONF, slaveconf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
3455 if (success) {
3456 driver_.write_only_regs_.slaveconf = slaveconf.value;
3457
3458 // Store send delay locally (SLAVECONF register is write-only)
3459 driver_.send_delay_ = constrain<uint8_t>(send_delay, 0U, 15U);
3460
3461 // Update UART node address (node address and slave address are the same)
3462 driver_.uart_node_address_ = node_address & 0xFF;
3463
3464 // Update driver config
3465 driver_.driver_config_.uart_config.node_address = node_address & 0xFF;
3466 driver_.driver_config_.uart_config.send_delay = constrain<uint8_t>(send_delay, 0U, 15U);
3467 }
3468
3469 return success;
3470
3471 // Update UART interface slave address if using UART
3472 if (driver_.comm_.GetMode() == CommMode::UART) {
3473 // Cast to UART interface and update address
3474 // Note: This requires the interface to be UartCommInterface
3475 // The user should also call SetUartNodeAddress on the interface directly if needed
3476 }
3477
3478 return true;
3479}

3481// Protection implementation
3482template <typename CommType>
3483bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Protection::ConfigureShortProtection(const PowerStageParameters& config) noexcept {
3484 // Update driver config (short protection is part of power_stage)
3485 driver_.driver_config_.power_stage = config;
3486
3487 // Convert user-friendly values to register values
3488 uint8_t s2vs_level = CalculateS2VSLevel(config.s2vs_voltage_mv);
3489 if (s2vs_level == 0 || s2vs_level < 4) {
3490 s2vs_level = 6; // Fallback to default
3491 }
3492
3493 // Get supply voltage from motor spec for S2G calculation
3494 uint32_t supply_voltage = 0;
3495 // Try to get from stored motor_spec_ if available, otherwise use 0 (will use VS<50V defaults)
3496 if (driver_.motor_spec_.supply_voltage_mv > 0) {
3497 supply_voltage = driver_.motor_spec_.supply_voltage_mv;
3498 }
3499
3500 uint8_t s2g_level = CalculateS2GLevel(config.s2g_voltage_mv, supply_voltage);
3501 if (s2g_level == 0 || s2g_level < 2) {
3502 s2g_level = 6; // Fallback to default
3503 }
3504
3505 uint8_t shortdelay = CalculateShortDelay(config.short_detection_delay_us_x10);
3506
3507 return SetShortProtectionLevels(s2vs_level, s2g_level, config.shortfilter, shortdelay);
3508}
3509
3510template <typename CommType>
3511bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Protection::SetShortProtectionLevels(uint8_t s2vs_level, uint8_t s2g_level, uint8_t shortfilter,
3512 uint8_t shortdelay) noexcept {
3513 SHORT_CONF_Register short_conf{};
3514 short_conf.bits.s2vs_level = constrain<decltype(s2vs_level)>(s2vs_level, 4U, 15U);
3515 short_conf.bits.s2g_level = constrain<decltype(s2g_level)>(s2g_level, 2U, 15U);
3516 short_conf.bits.shortfilter = constrain<uint8_t>(shortfilter, 0U, 3U);
3517 short_conf.bits.shortdelay = constrain<uint8_t>(shortdelay, 0U, 1U);
3518 bool success = driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SHORT_CONF, short_conf.value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
3519 if (success) {
3520 driver_.write_only_regs_.short_conf = short_conf.value;
3521 }
3522 return success;
3523}

3526template <typename CommType>
3527bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::GetTimeBetweenMicrosteps(uint32_t& time) noexcept {
3528 uint32_t value = 0;
3529 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::TSTEP, value)) {

3531 }

3533 return true;

3536template <typename CommType>
3537bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::GetMicrostepCounter(uint16_t& counter) noexcept {
3538 uint32_t value = 0;
3539 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::MSCNT, value)) {

3541 }

3545
3546template <typename CommType>
3547bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::GetMicrostepCurrent(int16_t& phase_a, int16_t& phase_b) noexcept {
3548 uint32_t value = 0;
3549 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::MSCURACT, value)) {
3550 return false;
3551 }
3552 MSCURACT_Register mscuract{};
3553 mscuract.value = value;
3554
3555 // CUR_B is bits 8..0 (signed 9-bit)
3556 auto cur_b_raw = static_cast<int16_t>(mscuract.bits.cur_b);
3557 if (cur_b_raw & 0x0100) { // Check sign bit (bit 8)
3558 cur_b_raw |= static_cast<int16_t>(0xFE00U); // Sign extend to 16-bit
3559 }
3560 phase_b = cur_b_raw;
3561
3562 // CUR_A is bits 24..16 (signed 9-bit)
3563 auto cur_a_raw = static_cast<int16_t>(mscuract.bits.cur_a);
3564 if (cur_a_raw & 0x0100) { // Check sign bit (bit 8)
3565 cur_a_raw |= static_cast<int16_t>(0xFE00U); // Sign extend to 16-bit
3566 }
3567 phase_a = cur_a_raw;
3568
3569 return true;
3570}

3572template <typename CommType>
3573bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::GetPwmScale(uint8_t& pwm_scale_sum, int16_t& pwm_scale_auto) noexcept {
3574 uint32_t value = 0;
3575 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::PWM_SCALE, value)) {
3576 return false;
3577 }
3578 PWM_SCALE_Register pwm_scale{};
3579 pwm_scale.value = value;
3580 pwm_scale_sum = static_cast<uint8_t>(pwm_scale.bits.pwm_scale_sum);
3581 // PWM_SCALE_AUTO is signed 9-bit (bits 24..16)
3582 auto auto_raw = static_cast<int16_t>(pwm_scale.bits.pwm_scale_auto);
3583 if (auto_raw & 0x0100) { // Check sign bit (bit 8 of the 9-bit field)
3584 auto_raw |= static_cast<int16_t>(0xFE00U); // Sign extend to 16-bit
3585 }
3586 pwm_scale_auto = auto_raw;
3587 return true;
3588}

3639bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::ReadGpioPins(uint32_t& io_pins) noexcept {

3642
3643template <typename CommType>
3644bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Communication::SetClkFreq(const ExternalClockConfig& config) noexcept {
3645 // Update driver config
3646 driver_.driver_config_.external_clk_config = config;
3647
3648 // Calculate internal clock frequency (f_clk_) from external clock configuration
3649 // If external_clk_config.frequency_hz > 0: use external clock at that frequency
3650 // If external_clk_config.frequency_hz == 0: use internal clock (12 MHz default)
3651 if (config.frequency_hz > 0) {
3652 driver_.f_clk_ = config.frequency_hz;
3653 // Validate external clock frequency range
3654 if (driver_.f_clk_ < ClockFreq::MIN_F_CLK || driver_.f_clk_ > ClockFreq::MAX_F_CLK) {
3655 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "TMC5160",
3656 "Invalid external clock frequency: %u Hz (valid range: %u-%u Hz). Using internal 12 MHz clock.",
3657 driver_.f_clk_, ClockFreq::MIN_F_CLK, ClockFreq::MAX_F_CLK);
3658 driver_.f_clk_ = ClockFreq::DEFAULT_F_CLK; // Fallback to internal clock
3659 }
3660 } else {
3661 // Use internal clock (default: 12 MHz)
3662 driver_.f_clk_ = ClockFreq::DEFAULT_F_CLK;
3663 }
3664
3665 // Configure clock source on CLK pin (optional)
3666 // If SetClkFreq() is not implemented, returns false and assumes internal clock (CLK tied to GND)
3667 // If SetClkFreq() is implemented:
3668 // - Pass frequency > 0 to use external clock at that frequency
3669 // - Pass 0 to explicitly use internal clock (CLK pin set to GND)
3670 // f_clk_ is used for all timing calculations regardless of clock source
3671 uint32_t clk_freq_to_set = (config.frequency_hz > 0) ? config.frequency_hz : 0;
3672 if (!driver_.comm_.SetClkFreq(clk_freq_to_set)) {
3673 if (clk_freq_to_set == 0) {
3674 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160",
3675 "Communication::SetClkFreq: Using internal oscillator (frequency_hz=0, CLK pin should be tied "
3676 "to GND, f_clk=%u Hz)",
3677 driver_.f_clk_);
3678 } else {
3679 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160",
3680 "Communication::SetClkFreq: Using internal oscillator (clock control not supported, CLK pin "
3681 "tied to GND, f_clk=%u Hz for calculations)",
3682 driver_.f_clk_);
3683 // Clock control not supported, but we still use the configured frequency for calculations
3684 // If external clock was requested but not supported, we fall back to internal
3685 if (config.frequency_hz > 0) {
3686 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TMC5160",
3687 "WARNING: External clock requested (%u Hz) but not supported, using internal 12 MHz clock",
3688 config.frequency_hz);
3689 driver_.f_clk_ = ClockFreq::DEFAULT_F_CLK; // Fallback to internal clock frequency
3690 }
3691 }
3692 } else {
3693 if (clk_freq_to_set == 0) {
3694 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160",
3695 "Communication::SetClkFreq: Internal clock enabled (CLK pin set to GND, f_clk=%u Hz)",
3696 driver_.f_clk_);
3697 } else {
3698 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(
3699 driver_.comm_, 2, "TMC5160",
3700 "Communication::SetClkFreq: External clock set to %u Hz on CLK pin (f_clk=%u Hz for calculations)",
3701 clk_freq_to_set, driver_.f_clk_);
3702 }
3703 }
3704
3705 return true;
3706}

3811template <typename CommType>
3812bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::ReadFactoryConfig(uint8_t& fclktrim) noexcept {
3813 uint32_t value = 0;
3814 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::FACTORY_CONF, value)) {
3815 return false;

3822template <typename CommType>
3823bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::SetSdoCfg0Polarity(bool polarity) noexcept {
3824 // Register 0x04 is dual purpose:
3825 // - Read: IOIN (Input states)
3826 // - Write: OUTPUT (Output configuration)
3827 //
3828 // Bit 0 of OUTPUT register controls the polarity of SDO_CFG0 pin in UART mode.
3829 // 0: Normal / Active High (Logic 1 = High Voltage)
3830 // 1: Inverted / Active Low (Logic 1 = Low Voltage) - Default reset value
3831 //
3832 // NOTE: Writing to 0x04 DOES NOT overwrite input flags (as they are read-only at this address).
3833 // Writing only affects the output configuration latch.
3834
3835 uint32_t value = polarity ? 1 : 0;
3836 return driver_.comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::OUTPUT, value, driver_.GetCommAddress());
3837}

3839template <typename CommType>
3840bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::ReadOtpConfig(uint8_t& otp_fclktrim, bool& otp_s2_level, bool& otp_bbm,

3843 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::OTP_READ, value)) {
3844 return false;

3848 otp_fclktrim = static_cast<uint8_t>(otp_read.bits.otp_fclktrim);
3849 otp_s2_level = otp_read.bits.otp_S2_level != 0;
3850 otp_bbm = otp_read.bits.otp_bbm != 0;
3851 otp_tbl = otp_read.bits.otp_tbl != 0;
3852 return true;

3877template <typename CommType>
3878bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Diagnostics::VerifySetup() noexcept {
3879 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "--- TMC5160 Setup Verification ---");
3880
3881 // 1. Check IC Version
3882 uint8_t version = 0;
3883 if (ReadIcVersion(version)) {
3884 if (version == 0x30) {
3885 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "IC Version: 0x30 (Matches TMC5160)");
3886 } else {
3887 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "VerifySetup", "IC Version MISMATCH: 0x%02X (Expected 0x30)", version);
3888 // If version is 0x00 or 0xFF, it's likely a communication error
3889 if (version == 0x00 || version == 0xFF) {
3890 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "VerifySetup", "CRITICAL: Bus communication likely failed!");
3891 return false;
3892 }
3893 }
3894 } else {
3895 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "VerifySetup", "Failed to read IC Version!");
3896 return false;
3897 }
3898
3899 // 2. Check Input Pins (Reg 0x04)
3900 InputStatus inputs;
3901 if (ReadInputStatus(inputs)) {
3902 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "--- Input Pins (IOIN 0x04) ---");
3903 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "REFL_STEP: %s", inputs.refl_step ? "HIGH" : "LOW");
3904 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "REFR_DIR: %s", inputs.refr_dir ? "HIGH" : "LOW");
3905 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "ENCB_DCEN_CFG4: %s", inputs.encb_dcen_cfg4 ? "HIGH" : "LOW");
3906 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "ENCA_DCIN_CFG5: %s", inputs.enca_dcin_cfg5 ? "HIGH" : "LOW");
3907 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "DRV_ENN: %s (Active LOW)",
3908 inputs.drv_enn ? "HIGH (Disabled)" : "LOW (Enabled)");
3909 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "ENC_N_DCO_CFG6: %s", inputs.enc_n_dco_cfg6 ? "HIGH" : "LOW");
3910 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "SD_MODE: %s %s", inputs.sd_mode ? "HIGH" : "LOW",
3911 inputs.sd_mode ? "(External Step/Dir)" : "(Internal Ramp)");
3912 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "SWCOMP_IN: %s", inputs.swcomp_in ? "HIGH" : "LOW");
3913
3914 // Warn about configuration mismatches
3915 if (inputs.drv_enn) {
3916 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup",
3917 "NOTE: DRV_ENN is HIGH. Driver power stage is currently DISABLED.");
3918 }
3919 } else {
3920 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "VerifySetup", "Failed to read Input Status!");
3921 }
3922
3923 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "VerifySetup", "----------------------------------");
3924 return true;
3925}
3926
3927// Helper function to test if a velocity works with a given SGT
3928template <typename CommType>
3929bool TestVelocityWithSGT(TMC51x0<CommType>& driver, float velocity_steps, int8_t sgt,
3930 uint16_t& sg_result_out, int sample_count = 8) {
3931 // Configure SGT
3932 StallGuardConfig sg_config{};
3933 sg_config.threshold = sgt;
3934 sg_config.enable_filter = false;
3935 if (!driver.diagnostics.ConfigureStallGuard(sg_config)) {
3936 return false;
3937 }
3938 driver.GetComm().DelayMs(10);
3939
3940 // Set velocity
3941 if (!driver.rampControl.SetMaxSpeed(velocity_steps, Unit::Steps)) {
3942 return false;
3943 }
3944
3945 // Wait for velocity to stabilize
3946 for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) { // 100 * 10ms = 1000ms timeout
3947 float current_speed = 0.0f;
3948 if (driver.rampControl.GetCurrentSpeed(current_speed, Unit::Steps) &&
3949 std::abs(current_speed - velocity_steps) < 50.0f) {
3950 break;
3951 }
3952 driver.GetComm().DelayMs(10);
3953 }
3954
3955 // Sample SG_RESULT
3956 uint16_t sg_sum = 0;
3957 uint16_t sg_count = 0;
3958 bool stall_detected = false;
3959
3960 for (int i = 0; i < sample_count; i++) {
3961 uint16_t sg_val = 0;
3962 if (driver.diagnostics.GetStallGuard(sg_val)) {
3963 if (sg_val == 0) {
3964 stall_detected = true;
3965 break;
3966 }
3967 sg_sum += sg_val;
3968 sg_count++;
3969 }
3970 driver.GetComm().DelayMs(5);
3971 }
3972
3973 if (stall_detected) {
3974 sg_result_out = 0;
3975 return false;
3976 }
3977
3978 sg_result_out = (sg_count > 0) ? (sg_sum / sg_count) : 0;
3979 return true;
3980}
3981
3982// Helper function to find working velocity range for a given SGT
3983template <typename CommType>
3984bool FindWorkingVelocityRange(TMC51x0<CommType>& driver, int8_t sgt, float start_velocity,
3985 float direction, float& found_velocity, uint16_t& sg_result_out,
3986 float min_velocity = 100.0f, float max_velocity = 100000.0f) {
3987 float test_velocity = start_velocity;
3988 const float step_size = (direction > 0) ? 1000.0f : -1000.0f; // 1000 steps/s steps
3989 const int max_iterations = 50;
3990
3991 for (int i = 0; i < max_iterations; i++) {
3992 // Clamp to reasonable range
3993 if (test_velocity < min_velocity) {
3994 test_velocity = min_velocity;
3995 }
3996 if (test_velocity > max_velocity) {
3997 test_velocity = max_velocity;
3998 }
3999
4000 if (TestVelocityWithSGT(driver, test_velocity, sgt, sg_result_out)) {
4001 found_velocity = test_velocity;
4002 return true;
4003 }
4004
4005 test_velocity += step_size;
4006
4007 // Check if we've gone out of bounds
4008 if ((direction > 0 && test_velocity > max_velocity) ||
4009 (direction < 0 && test_velocity < min_velocity)) {
4010 break;
4011 }
4012 }
4013
4014 return false;
4015}
4016
4017template <typename CommType>
4018bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Tuning::TuneStallGuard(float target_velocity, StallGuardTuningResult& result,
4019 int8_t min_sgt, int8_t max_sgt, float acceleration,
4020 float min_velocity, float max_velocity,
4021 Unit velocity_unit, Unit acceleration_unit) noexcept {
4022 // Initialize result
4023 result = StallGuardTuningResult{};
4024
4025 // Convert inputs to steps
4026 float target_v_steps = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(target_velocity, velocity_unit);
4027 float min_v_steps = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(min_velocity, velocity_unit);
4028 float max_v_steps = driver_.convertSpeedToSteps(max_velocity, velocity_unit);
4029 float accel_steps = driver_.convertAccelerationToSteps(acceleration, acceleration_unit);
4030
4031 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4032 "Starting comprehensive SGT tuning. Target=%.2f, Min=%.2f, Max=%.2f steps/s",
4033 target_v_steps, min_v_steps, max_v_steps);
4034
4035 // 0. CRITICAL: Ensure stop-on-stall is DISABLED
4036 if (!driver_.diagnostics.EnableStopOnStall(false)) {
4037 return false;
4038 }
4039
4040 // Clear any previous stop events/flags
4041 driver_.diagnostics.ClearStallFlag();
4042 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(10);
4043
4044 // 1. Start with SGT=0 (datasheet recommendation) or min_sgt if higher
4045 int8_t current_sgt = (min_sgt < 0) ? 0 : min_sgt;
4046 if (current_sgt != min_sgt) {
4047 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4048 "Adjusted starting SGT from %d to %d (avoiding false stalls)", min_sgt, current_sgt);
4049 }
4050
4051 // Enable velocity mode for continuous motion during tuning
4052 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetRampMode(RampMode::VELOCITY_POS)) {
4053 return false;
4054 }
4055
4056 // Set explicit acceleration
4057 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetAccelerations(accel_steps, accel_steps, Unit::Steps)) {
4058 return false;
4059 }
4060
4061 // Start motion at target velocity
4062 if (!driver_.rampControl.SetMaxSpeed(target_v_steps, Unit::Steps)) {
4063 return false;
4064 }
4065
4066 // Wait for motor to reach target speed
4067 bool velocity_reached = false;
4068 for (int i = 0; i < 500; i++) { // 500 * 10ms = 5000ms timeout
4069 if (driver_.rampControl.IsTargetVelocityReached()) {
4070 velocity_reached = true;
4071 break;
4072 }
4073 float current_speed = 0.0f;
4074 if (driver_.rampControl.GetCurrentSpeed(current_speed, Unit::Steps) &&
4075 std::abs(current_speed - target_v_steps) < 100.0f) {
4076 velocity_reached = true;
4077 break;
4078 }
4079 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(10);
4080 }
4081
4082 if (!velocity_reached) {
4083 float current_speed_debug = 0.0f;
4084 driver_.rampControl.GetCurrentSpeed(current_speed_debug, Unit::Steps);
4085 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4086 "Warning: Target velocity not reached before tuning (V=%.1f)", current_speed_debug);
4087 }
4088
4089 // 2. PRIMARY GOAL: Find optimal SGT at target velocity (most important)
4090 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4091 "Phase 1: Finding optimal SGT at target velocity %.2f steps/s", target_v_steps);
4092
4093 // First, find the range of working SGT values
4094 int8_t min_working_sgt = -1;
4095 int8_t max_working_sgt = -1;
4096 int8_t best_sgt = -1;
4097 uint16_t best_sg_result = 0;
4098 const uint16_t target_sg_result = 200; // Target SG_RESULT for optimal sensitivity (100-500 range is good)
4099 uint16_t best_sg_diff = 1023; // Difference from target
4100
4101 // Scan through SGT range to find all working values
4102 while (current_sgt <= max_sgt) {
4103 // Update SGT
4104 StallGuardConfig sg_config{};
4105 sg_config.threshold = current_sgt;
4106 sg_config.enable_filter = false; // Disable filter during tuning
4107 if (!driver_.diagnostics.ConfigureStallGuard(sg_config)) {
4108 driver_.rampControl.Stop();
4109 return false;
4110 }
4111
4112 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(10);
4113
4114 // Sample SG_RESULT multiple times at target velocity
4115 bool stall_indicated = false;
4116 uint16_t sg_sum = 0;
4117 uint16_t sg_count = 0;
4118
4119 for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
4120 uint16_t sg_val = 0;
4121 if (driver_.diagnostics.GetStallGuard(sg_val)) {
4122 if (sg_val == 0) {
4123 stall_indicated = true;
4124 break;
4125 }
4126 sg_sum += sg_val;
4127 sg_count++;
4128 }
4129 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(5);
4130 }
4131
4132 if (stall_indicated) {
4133 // Check if motor stopped unexpectedly
4134 float vact = 0.0f;
4135 if (driver_.rampControl.GetCurrentSpeed(vact, Unit::Steps) && std::abs(vact) < 10.0f) {
4136 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4137 "Motor stopped during tuning! (V=%.1f). Restarting...", vact);
4138 driver_.diagnostics.EnableStopOnStall(false);
4139 driver_.diagnostics.ClearStallFlag();
4140 driver_.rampControl.SetMaxSpeed(target_v_steps, Unit::Steps);
4141 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(200);
4142 }
4143
4144 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TuneStallGuard",
4145 "SGT %d too low at target velocity (SG=0), increasing...", current_sgt);
4146 current_sgt++;
4147 } else {
4148 // This SGT works - record it
4149 uint16_t avg_sg_result = (sg_count > 0) ? (sg_sum / sg_count) : 0;
4150
4151 if (min_working_sgt == -1) {
4152 min_working_sgt = current_sgt; // First working SGT
4153 }
4154 max_working_sgt = current_sgt; // Last working SGT so far
4155
4156 // Calculate how close this SG_RESULT is to our target (200 is ideal for good sensitivity)
4157 uint16_t sg_diff = (avg_sg_result > target_sg_result) ?
4158 (avg_sg_result - target_sg_result) :
4159 (target_sg_result - avg_sg_result);
4160
4161 // Prefer SG_RESULT in range 100-500 (good sensitivity range)
4162 // Closer to 200 is better, but anything in 100-500 is acceptable
4163 if (avg_sg_result >= 100 && avg_sg_result <= 500) {
4164 if (sg_diff < best_sg_diff) {
4165 best_sgt = current_sgt;
4166 best_sg_result = avg_sg_result;
4167 best_sg_diff = sg_diff;
4168 }
4169 } else if (best_sgt == -1) {
4170 // If no SGT in ideal range yet, use this one as fallback
4171 best_sgt = current_sgt;
4172 best_sg_result = avg_sg_result;
4173 best_sg_diff = sg_diff;
4174 }
4175
4176 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "TuneStallGuard",
4177 "SGT %d works: SG_RESULT=%u (diff from target=%u)",
4178 current_sgt, avg_sg_result, sg_diff);
4179
4180 current_sgt++;
4181 }
4182 }
4183
4184 // Determine optimal SGT
4185 if (min_working_sgt == -1) {
4186 // No working SGT found
4187 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "TuneStallGuard",
4188 "Failed to find any working SGT at target velocity. Reached max SGT %d.", max_sgt);
4189 driver_.rampControl.Stop();
4190 return false;
4191 }
4192
4193 // If we found a best SGT (in ideal range), use it; otherwise use middle of working range
4194 if (best_sgt != -1) {
4195 result.optimal_sgt = best_sgt;
4196 result.target_velocity_sg_result = best_sg_result;
4197 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4198 "Optimal SGT found: %d (SG_RESULT=%u, in ideal range 100-500)",
4199 best_sgt, best_sg_result);
4200 } else {
4201 // Use middle of working range for stability
4202 result.optimal_sgt = (min_working_sgt + max_working_sgt) / 2;
4203 // Re-test to get actual SG_RESULT at optimal SGT
4204 StallGuardConfig sg_config{};
4205 sg_config.threshold = result.optimal_sgt;
4206 sg_config.enable_filter = false;
4207 driver_.diagnostics.ConfigureStallGuard(sg_config);
4208 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(10);
4209
4210 uint16_t sg_sum = 0;
4211 uint16_t sg_count = 0;
4212 for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
4213 uint16_t sg_val = 0;
4214 if (driver_.diagnostics.GetStallGuard(sg_val) && sg_val > 0) {
4215 sg_sum += sg_val;
4216 sg_count++;
4217 }
4218 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(5);
4219 }
4220 result.target_velocity_sg_result = (sg_count > 0) ? (sg_sum / sg_count) : 0;
4221
4222 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4223 "Optimal SGT found: %d (middle of working range %d-%d, SG_RESULT=%u)",
4224 result.optimal_sgt, min_working_sgt, max_working_sgt, result.target_velocity_sg_result);
4225 }
4226
4227 result.tuning_success = true;
4228
4229 // 3. SECONDARY GOAL: Verify optimal SGT works at min/max velocities (if specified)
4230 if (min_v_steps > 0.0f || max_v_steps > 0.0f) {
4231 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4232 "Phase 2: Verifying optimal SGT %d at min/max velocities", result.optimal_sgt);
4233
4234 // Test at min velocity
4235 if (min_v_steps > 0.0f) {
4236 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4237 "Testing min velocity %.2f steps/s with SGT %d", min_v_steps, result.optimal_sgt);
4238
4239 if (TestVelocityWithSGT(driver_, min_v_steps, result.optimal_sgt, result.min_velocity_sg_result)) {
4240 result.min_velocity_success = true;
4241 result.min_velocity_sgt = result.optimal_sgt;
4242 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4243 "Min velocity works! SG_RESULT=%u", result.min_velocity_sg_result);
4244 } else {
4245 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4246 "Min velocity %.2f does NOT work with optimal SGT %d. Finding working min velocity...",
4247 min_v_steps, result.optimal_sgt);
4248
4249 // Try to find a working min velocity (search downward from target)
4250 float found_min_vel = 0.0f;
4251 if (FindWorkingVelocityRange(driver_, result.optimal_sgt, target_v_steps, -1.0f,
4252 found_min_vel, result.min_velocity_sg_result, 100.0f, target_v_steps)) {
4253 result.actual_min_velocity = driver_.convertSpeedToUnit(found_min_vel, velocity_unit);
4254 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4255 "Found working min velocity: %.2f (SG_RESULT=%u)",
4256 result.actual_min_velocity, result.min_velocity_sg_result);
4257 } else {
4258 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4259 "Could not find working min velocity with optimal SGT");
4260 }
4261 }
4262 }
4263
4264 // Test at max velocity
4265 if (max_v_steps > 0.0f) {
4266 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4267 "Testing max velocity %.2f steps/s with SGT %d", max_v_steps, result.optimal_sgt);
4268
4269 if (TestVelocityWithSGT(driver_, max_v_steps, result.optimal_sgt, result.max_velocity_sg_result)) {
4270 result.max_velocity_success = true;
4271 result.max_velocity_sgt = result.optimal_sgt;
4272 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4273 "Max velocity works! SG_RESULT=%u", result.max_velocity_sg_result);
4274 } else {
4275 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4276 "Max velocity %.2f does NOT work with optimal SGT %d. Finding working max velocity...",
4277 max_v_steps, result.optimal_sgt);
4278
4279 // Try to find a working max velocity (search upward from target)
4280 float found_max_vel = 0.0f;
4281 if (FindWorkingVelocityRange(driver_, result.optimal_sgt, target_v_steps, 1.0f,
4282 found_max_vel, result.max_velocity_sg_result, target_v_steps, 100000.0f)) {
4283 result.actual_max_velocity = driver_.convertSpeedToUnit(found_max_vel, velocity_unit);
4284 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4285 "Found working max velocity: %.2f (SG_RESULT=%u)",
4286 result.actual_max_velocity, result.max_velocity_sg_result);
4287 } else {
4288 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4289 "Could not find working max velocity with optimal SGT");
4290 }
4291 }
4292 }
4293 }
4294
4295 // Stop motor
4296 driver_.rampControl.Stop();
4297
4298 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "TuneStallGuard",
4299 "Tuning complete. Optimal SGT=%d, Min success=%d, Max success=%d",
4300 result.optimal_sgt, result.min_velocity_success, result.max_velocity_success);
4301
4302 return true;
4303}

4305// Legacy overload for backward compatibility
4306template <typename CommType>
4307bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Tuning::TuneStallGuard(float target_velocity, int8_t& final_sgt, int8_t min_sgt,
4308 int8_t max_sgt, float acceleration, float min_velocity,
4309 float max_velocity, Unit velocity_unit, Unit acceleration_unit) noexcept {
4310 // Call the new comprehensive function and extract just the optimal SGT
4311 StallGuardTuningResult result;
4312 bool success = TuneStallGuard(target_velocity, result, min_sgt, max_sgt, acceleration,
4313 min_velocity, max_velocity, velocity_unit, acceleration_unit);
4314
4315 if (success) {
4316 final_sgt = result.optimal_sgt;
4317 }
4318
4319 return success;
4320}
4321
4322// AutoTuneStallGuard implementation
4323template <typename CommType>
4324bool TMC51x0<CommType>::Tuning::AutoTuneStallGuard(float target_velocity, StallGuardTuningResult& result,
4325 int8_t min_sgt, int8_t max_sgt, float acceleration,
4326 float min_velocity, float max_velocity, Unit velocity_unit,
4327 Unit acceleration_unit, uint16_t safe_current_margin_mA) noexcept {
4328 // Initialize result
4329 result = StallGuardTuningResult{};
4330
4331 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4332 "Starting comprehensive StallGuard tuning with current margin=%u mA",
4333 safe_current_margin_mA);
4334
4335 // ========================================================================
4336 // STEP 1: Save current motor settings
4337 // ========================================================================
4338 struct SavedSettings {
4339 uint8_t saved_irun{0};
4340 uint8_t saved_ihold{0};
4341 uint16_t saved_global_scaler{0};
4342 CoolStepConfig saved_coolstep{};
4343 StallGuardConfig saved_stallguard{};
4344 bool settings_saved{false};
4345 } saved;
4346
4347 // Use cached values directly as IHOLD_IRUN is write-only
4348 saved.saved_irun = driver_.calculated_irun_;
4349 saved.saved_ihold = driver_.calculated_ihold_;
4350 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4351 "Using cached IHOLD_IRUN: IRUN=%u, IHOLD=%u",
4352 saved.saved_irun, saved.saved_ihold);
4353
4354 // Use cached value as GLOBAL_SCALER is write-only (TMC5160 only)
4355 if (driver_.chip_version_ != ChipVersion::TMC5130) {
4356 saved.saved_global_scaler = driver_.calculated_global_scaler_;
4357 if (saved.saved_global_scaler == 0) {
4358 saved.saved_global_scaler = 256; // 0 means 256
4359 }
4360 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4361 "Using cached GLOBAL_SCALER: %u",
4362 saved.saved_global_scaler);
4363 }
4364
4365 // Save current CoolStep config
4366 saved.saved_coolstep = driver_.driver_config_.coolstep;
4367
4368 // Save current StallGuard config
4369 saved.saved_stallguard = driver_.driver_config_.stallguard;
4370
4371 saved.settings_saved = true;
4372 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4373 "Saved settings: IRUN=%u, IHOLD=%u, GLOBAL_SCALER=%u",
4374 saved.saved_irun, saved.saved_ihold, saved.saved_global_scaler);
4375
4376 // ========================================================================
4377 // STEP 2: Apply safe current margin if specified
4378 // ========================================================================
4379 bool current_was_reduced = false;
4380 if (safe_current_margin_mA > 0) {
4381 // Calculate current RMS from saved settings
4382 // I_RMS = (GLOBAL_SCALER/256) * ((IRUN+1)/32) * (VFS/RSENSE) * (1/√2)
4383 constexpr float VFS = 0.325F;
4384 constexpr float SQRT2 = 1.41421356237F;
4385 float rsense_ohm = static_cast<float>(driver_.motor_spec_.sense_resistor_mohm) / 1000.0F;
4386
4387 if (rsense_ohm > 0.0F && driver_.motor_spec_.sense_resistor_mohm > 0) {
4388 float current_rms_a = (static_cast<float>(saved.saved_global_scaler) / 256.0F) *
4389 (static_cast<float>(saved.saved_irun + 1) / 32.0F) * (VFS / rsense_ohm) / SQRT2;
4390 uint16_t current_rms_ma = static_cast<uint16_t>(current_rms_a * 1000.0F);
4391
4392 // Calculate new current with margin
4393 uint16_t new_current_ma = (current_rms_ma > safe_current_margin_mA) ?
4394 (current_rms_ma - safe_current_margin_mA) : 0;
4395
4396 // Ensure minimum current (at least 100mA or 20% of original, whichever is higher)
4397 uint16_t min_current_ma = std::max(static_cast<uint16_t>(100U),
4398 static_cast<uint16_t>(current_rms_ma * 0.2F));
4399 if (new_current_ma < min_current_ma) {
4400 new_current_ma = min_current_ma;
4401 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4402 "Current margin would reduce current too low, using minimum: %u mA",
4403 new_current_ma);
4404 }
4405
4406 if (new_current_ma > 0 && new_current_ma < current_rms_ma) {
4407 // Calculate new IRUN and GLOBAL_SCALER from reduced current
4408 uint8_t new_irun = 0;
4409 uint8_t new_ihold = 0;
4410 uint16_t new_scaler = 0;
4411
4412 // Calculate hold current proportionally from original hold current
4413 // First calculate original hold current RMS
4414 float original_hold_rms_a = (static_cast<float>(saved.saved_global_scaler) / 256.0F) *
4415 (static_cast<float>(saved.saved_ihold + 1) / 32.0F) * (VFS / rsense_ohm) / SQRT2;
4416 uint16_t original_hold_ma = static_cast<uint16_t>(original_hold_rms_a * 1000.0F);
4417
4418 // Scale hold current proportionally to run current reduction
4419 float current_ratio = static_cast<float>(new_current_ma) / static_cast<float>(current_rms_ma);
4420 uint16_t new_hold_current_ma = static_cast<uint16_t>(static_cast<float>(original_hold_ma) * current_ratio);
4421
4422 if (CalculateMotorCurrent(driver_.motor_spec_, driver_.motor_spec_.sense_resistor_mohm,
4423 driver_.motor_spec_.supply_voltage_mv, new_current_ma, new_hold_current_ma,
4424 new_irun, new_ihold, new_scaler)) {
4425 // Ensure minimum IRUN=8 for StealthChop compatibility
4426 if (new_irun < 8) {
4427 new_irun = 8;
4428 // Recalculate scaler for IRUN=8
4429 float run_current_a = static_cast<float>(new_current_ma) / 1000.0F;
4430 float scaler_float = (run_current_a * 256.0F * 32.0F) / (9.0F * (VFS / rsense_ohm) / SQRT2);
4431 new_scaler = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::round(scaler_float));
4432 new_scaler = std::max<uint16_t>(new_scaler, 32U);
4433 new_scaler = std::min<uint16_t>(new_scaler, 256U);
4434 }
4435
4436 // Apply new current settings
4437 if (driver_.chip_version_ != ChipVersion::TMC5130) {
4438 if (!driver_.motorControl.SetGlobalScaler(new_scaler)) {
4439 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4440 "Failed to set GLOBAL_SCALER for current margin");
4441 // Continue anyway - might still work
4442 }
4443 }
4444
4445 if (!driver_.motorControl.SetCurrent(new_irun, new_ihold)) {
4446 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4447 "Failed to set current for current margin");
4448 // Continue anyway - might still work
4449 } else {
4450 current_was_reduced = true;
4451 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4452 "Reduced current: %u mA -> %u mA (IRUN: %u->%u, SCALER: %u->%u)",
4453 current_rms_ma, new_current_ma, saved.saved_irun, new_irun,
4454 saved.saved_global_scaler, new_scaler);
4455 }
4456 } else {
4457 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4458 "Could not calculate new current settings, using original current");
4459 }
4460 }
4461 } else {
4462 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4463 "Cannot apply current margin: sense resistor not configured");
4464 }
4465 }
4466
4467 // ========================================================================
4468 // STEP 3: Disable CoolStep (SGMIN=0)
4469 // ========================================================================
4470 CoolStepConfig coolstep_disabled{};
4471 coolstep_disabled.lower_threshold_sg = 0; // Disable CoolStep
4472 coolstep_disabled.enable_filter = false; // Disable filter during tuning
4473 if (!driver_.motorControl.ConfigureCoolStep(coolstep_disabled)) {
4474 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4475 "Failed to disable CoolStep");
4476 // Continue anyway
4477 } else {
4478 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "AutoTuneStallGuard", "CoolStep disabled for tuning");
4479 }
4480
4481 // ========================================================================
4482 // STEP 4: Explicitly disable StallGuard filter (SFILT=0) for tuning
4483 // ========================================================================
4484 // Configure StallGuard with filter disabled (TuneStallGuard will also do this, but
4485 // we do it here to ensure it's set before any tuning operations)
4486 StallGuardConfig sg_config_no_filter{};
4487 sg_config_no_filter.threshold = 0; // Temporary, will be set during tuning
4488 sg_config_no_filter.enable_filter = false; // Disable filter for immediate response
4489 if (!driver_.diagnostics.ConfigureStallGuard(sg_config_no_filter)) {
4490 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4491 "Failed to configure StallGuard filter (non-critical)");
4492 // Continue anyway - TuneStallGuard will set it
4493 }
4494
4495 // ========================================================================
4496 // STEP 5: Disable stop-on-stall and clear stall flags
4497 // ========================================================================
4498 if (!driver_.diagnostics.EnableStopOnStall(false)) {
4499 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4500 "Failed to disable stop-on-stall");
4501 // Continue anyway
4502 }
4503 driver_.diagnostics.ClearStallFlag();
4504 driver_.comm_.DelayMs(10);
4505
4506 // ========================================================================
4507 // STEP 6: Perform comprehensive SGT tuning using existing function
4508 // ========================================================================
4509 // Adjust min_sgt to start at 0 if negative (to avoid false stalls)
4510 int8_t adjusted_min_sgt = (min_sgt < 0) ? 0 : min_sgt;
4511 if (adjusted_min_sgt != min_sgt) {
4512 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4513 "Adjusted min_sgt from %d to %d (avoiding false stalls)", min_sgt, adjusted_min_sgt);
4514 }
4515
4516 bool tuning_success = TuneStallGuard(target_velocity, result, adjusted_min_sgt, max_sgt,
4517 acceleration, min_velocity, max_velocity, velocity_unit, acceleration_unit);
4518
4519 // ========================================================================
4520 // STEP 7: Restore all saved settings
4521 // ========================================================================
4522 bool restore_success = true;
4523
4524 // Restore motor current if it was reduced
4525 if (current_was_reduced && saved.settings_saved) {
4526 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4527 "Restoring motor current: IRUN=%u, IHOLD=%u, GLOBAL_SCALER=%u",
4528 saved.saved_irun, saved.saved_ihold, saved.saved_global_scaler);
4529
4530 if (driver_.chip_version_ != ChipVersion::TMC5130) {
4531 if (!driver_.motorControl.SetGlobalScaler(saved.saved_global_scaler)) {
4532 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4533 "Failed to restore GLOBAL_SCALER");
4534 restore_success = false;
4535 }
4536 }
4537
4538 if (!driver_.motorControl.SetCurrent(saved.saved_irun, saved.saved_ihold)) {
4539 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4540 "Failed to restore motor current");
4541 restore_success = false;
4542 } else {
4543 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4544 "Motor current restored successfully");
4545 }
4546 }
4547
4548 // Restore CoolStep configuration
4549 if (saved.settings_saved) {
4550 if (!driver_.motorControl.ConfigureCoolStep(saved.saved_coolstep)) {
4551 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4552 "Failed to restore CoolStep configuration (non-critical)");
4553 // Non-critical, continue
4554 } else {
4555 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 2, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4556 "CoolStep configuration restored");
4557 }
4558 }
4559
4560 // Note: StallGuard configuration (SGT) is intentionally NOT restored
4561 // because the optimal SGT found during tuning should remain active.
4562 // The user can configure it explicitly if needed.
4563
4564 if (!restore_success) {
4565 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4566 "Warning: Some settings could not be restored");
4567 }
4568
4569 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 1, "AutoTuneStallGuard",
4570 "Tuning complete. Success=%d, Optimal SGT=%d",
4571 tuning_success, result.optimal_sgt);
4572
4573 return tuning_success;
4574}
4575
4576// UartConfig implementation
4577template <typename CommType>
4578bool TMC51x0<CommType>::UartConfig::ConfigureUartNodeAddress(uint8_t node_address, uint8_t send_delay) noexcept {
4579 // During sequential programming, the device is accessible at address 0
4580 // (first device: NAI=GND, subsequent devices: previous NAO=LOW)
4581 // We need to use address 0 to communicate, not the target address
4582 uint8_t current_accessible_address = 0;
4583
4584 SLAVECONF_Register slaveconf{};
4585 slaveconf.bits.slaveaddr = node_address & 0xFF; // Address range is 0-254 (8-bit)
4586 slaveconf.bits.senddelay = constrain<decltype(send_delay)>(send_delay, 0U, 15U);
4587
4588 // Write to SLAVECONF using current accessible address (0)
4589 bool success = driver_->comm_.WriteRegister(Registers::SLAVECONF, slaveconf.value, current_accessible_address);
4590
4591 // Only update the driver's node address and send delay after successful programming
4592 if (success) {
4593 driver_->write_only_regs_.slaveconf = slaveconf.value;
4594 driver_->uart_node_address_ = node_address & 0xFF; // Address range is 0-254
4595 driver_->send_delay_ = constrain<decltype(send_delay)>(send_delay, 0U, 15U); // Store send delay locally
4596 }
4597
4598 return success;
4599}

4602// PRINTER METHODS

4604
4605template <typename CommType>
4606void TMC51x0<CommType>::Printer::PrintRegisterField(const char* name, uint32_t value, const char* format) noexcept {
4607 char format_str[64];
4608 snprintf(format_str, sizeof(format_str), " %%s: %s", format);
4609 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 3, "Printer", format_str, name, value);
4610}
4611
4612template <typename CommType>
4613void TMC51x0<CommType>::Printer::PrintGconf() noexcept {
4614 uint32_t value = 0;
4615 if (!driver_.comm_.ReadRegister(Registers::GCONF, value)) {
4616 TMC51X0_LOG_DEBUG(driver_.comm_, 0, "Printer", "Error reading GCONF");
4617 return;
4618 }
4619
4620 GCONF_Register gconf{};
4621 gconf.value = value;
